providers.description: Ferra is a smart home strength-training system for adults aged 50 and over, built by Aroleap Fitness Private Limited in Bengaluru, India. It pairs a compact wall-mounted adaptive-resistance machine with a mobile app that queues a short guided daily workout of seven functional movements, adapts the weight in real time, tracks progress, and lets users share achievements with family. The service is sold as a no-lock-in monthly subscription (Individual, Duo, and Family tiers) billed through UPI auto-debit. Ferra is a consumer product with no public developer platform or API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network. Backed by Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: Onecard
providers.description: OneCard is a mobile-first metal credit card from India's FPL Technologies, a fintech unicorn that reimagines credit and payments with full-stack, in-house technology. OneCard is issued in partnership with banks including Bank of Baroda, CSB Bank, Federal Bank, SBM Bank, South Indian Bank and Indian Bank, and emphasizes simplicity, transparency and giving control back to the user. FPL Technologies also operates OneScore (credit-score monitoring) and Wizely (savings). Backed by QED Investors, OneCard is a consumer-facing product; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: PB Health
providers.description: PB Health (PB Healthcare Service Pvt Ltd) is an India-based consumer healthcare network offering end-to-end care through a single app - online doctor consultations, hospital visits and admissions, lab tests and radiology scans, medicine ordering, diabetes and obesity management, preventive health packages, and structured home care and recovery. The platform spans top specialities including cardiology, gastroenterology, orthopaedics, pulmonology, internal medicine, gynaecology, ENT, paediatrics, and minimal-access and bariatric surgery, and helps families coordinate their complete health and insurance journey. PB Health is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and website; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Refyne
providers.description: Refyne is an Indian financial wellness platform and the country's first earned wage access (EWA) provider, letting employees draw a portion of their already-earned salary before payday at 0% interest through their employer's payroll. Founded in 2020 and backed by QED Investors, Refyne serves 500+ organizations across 23 industries and more than 8 million employees, and operates additional products including RuPay credit cards, the MoneyGuru financial-literacy service, and an employee privilege/discount club. The company operates under RBI compliance and holds ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications. Refyne is primarily a B2B2C mobile and payroll-integrated platform and does not publish a public developer portal or API at this time; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Cars24
providers.description: Cars24 (CARS24 Services Private Limited) is one of India's largest auto-tech companies and an online marketplace for buying and selling used cars, operating across India, the UAE, and Australia. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, Cars24 is an RBI-registered NBFC that combines a used-car transaction platform with financing, insurance, and vehicle-management services. Its offerings include buying and selling pre-owned cars with 300+ point inspections, fixed transparent pricing, warranties, and doorstep delivery; AI-driven used-car valuation; new-car discovery; traffic challan checking and payment; pre-delivery inspections across 220+ cities; vehicle history and service-history reports; car scrapping; FASTag recharge; and used-car loans, loan-against-car, and personal-loan products through Bikes24, Insure24, and related brands. Cars24 is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and 500 Global. It is a consumer platform and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, agent-facing llms.txt, and security posture.

providers.name: Ummeed Housing Finance
providers.description: Ummeed Housing Finance Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian affordable-housing finance company registered with the National Housing Bank (NHB), providing home loans, loans against property, business loans, and MSME business loans to low- and middle-income households. Headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, it operates 130+ branches across 9 states and has served 45,000+ families. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Ummeed publishes no public developer portal or API surface; its digital channels are the customer website and a customer mobile app.

providers.name: Drivio
providers.description: Drivio (Drivio Technologies Pvt Ltd) is a tech-enabled, omni-channel two-wheeler financing marketplace in India that connects motorcycle, scooter, and electric-vehicle buyers with banks and NBFCs. Founded in 2022 by Saurabh Tripathi and Ankur Bhardwaj and headquartered in the Delhi NCR region (Gurugram / New Delhi), the platform offers EMI calculators, instant eligibility checks, curated finance offers, vehicle comparison, and same-day loan approval and disbursal through lending partners including IDFC First Bank, Bajaj Auto Credit, L&T Financial Services, HDB Financial Services, Moneyplus Financial Services, and Arthmate. Drivio is an ISO/IEC 27001 certified company and is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Slice
providers.description: Slice is an Indian consumer fintech and small finance bank, founded in 2016 as SlicePay by Rajan Bajaj and headquartered between Bengaluru (corporate) and Guwahati (registered). The company originally built a buy-now-pay-later product and a prepaid-card-plus-credit-line offering aimed at students and young professionals — pitched as a credit-card alternative for India's Gen Z — and at its peak was reportedly issuing over 300,000 prepaid cards per month before RBI's 2022 restrictions on credit-linked PPI products forced a pivot. In October 2023 Slice announced a merger with the regulated North East Small Finance Bank (NESFB), the first fintech-into-bank merger in India; the merger received RBI approval in October 2023, CCI approval in March 2024 and NCLT (Guwahati) approval in August 2024, completed on October 27, 2024, and the combined entity was rebranded as Slice Small Finance Bank in May 2025. Today Slice operates a consumer mobile-first neobank — savings accounts, fixed deposits, UPI, a Slice credit card and rewards — alongside a merchant-facing payments stack exposed through a Merchant API (api.nebank.com) covering bank-account validation, payouts, pay-in/collect, refunds, virtual accounts, balance, transactions and webhook notifications. As of late 2024 the company had raised approximately $387M from investors including Tiger Global, Insight Partners and Blume Ventures.

providers.name: Jiraaf
providers.description: Jiraaf (Jiraaf Platform Private Limited, Bangalore, India) is an online fixed-income investment platform that lets retail investors discover, analyze, and invest in listed and secured bonds. Its curated product shelf spans listed corporate bonds, sovereign gold bonds, treasury bills, G-Secs and State Development Loans (SDLs), securitized debt instruments (SDIs), and fixed deposits, each surfaced with transparent yields, credit ratings, and a documented credit-evaluation process. Alongside the investing surface it publishes research reports, a bond analyser, a bond directory, a glossary, calculators, and educational content (Bond Gurukul webinars, blogs, and newsletters). Backed by Accel. Jiraaf is a consumer-facing web and mobile investing product and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Oxyzo
providers.description: Oxyzo Financial Services is an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing customized SME and corporate financing across India. Founded as the lending arm of the OfBusiness group, Oxyzo offers purchase finance, work order finance, invoice discounting, vendor finance, business loans, machinery finance, and loan against property, serving industries such as auto manufacturing, capital goods, e-mobility, logistics, pharmaceuticals, and textiles. The company operates 145+ branches, has powered 10,000+ businesses, disbursed over Rs 77,000 crore, and holds A+ ratings from CRISIL and ICRA. Oxyzo publishes no public developer/API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Udaan
providers.description: Udaan is India's largest eB2B trade platform, connecting small businesses - kirana stores, chemists, hotels, restaurants, and offices - with manufacturers, brands, and wholesalers across categories including FMCG, staples, fruits and vegetables, pharma, and general merchandise. The platform combines supply chain and logistics operations with financial services for small businesses through udaanCapital, its working-capital fintech arm. Udaan is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and GGV Capital. It publishes no public developer API; buyer and seller experiences are delivered through its web and mobile apps, with api.udaan.com serving as the private app backend.

providers.name: Upswing
providers.description: Upswing Financial Technologies is an Indian open finance-as-a-service platform headquartered in Bengaluru and Mumbai. Its full-stack API platform lets consumer companies embed financial products such as deposits and lending from regulated partner banks (AU Small Finance Bank, DCB Bank, Utkarsh, Shivalik, Unity, South Indian Bank, Suryoday), while Upswing manages the bank integrations and compliance. Backed by QED Investors and Quona Capital. Upswing publishes no public developer portal or API documentation; its APIs are offered to partners under commercial agreements.

providers.name: Vedantu
providers.description: Vedantu is an Indian online-learning (edtech) company headquartered in Bangalore that delivers LIVE interactive classes, recorded courses, offline centres, and one-to-one tutoring for school students from Class 1 to 12 and competitive-exam aspirants, covering CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE and major State Boards plus JEE, NEET, CUET and Olympiad preparation, alongside a large free library of NCERT solutions, revision notes, sample papers and study material. Backed by Accel, Vedantu is consumer-facing and operates no public developer API today; its only published integration surface is a legacy External-Integration (EI) kit for institutes on GitHub, though it does publish an llms.txt for agents.

providers.name: Vridhi Home Finance
providers.description: Vridhi Home Finance (Vridhi Finserv Home Finance Limited) is an affordable housing finance company (HFC) headquartered in Bengaluru, India, founded in 2022. Operating as a tech-enabled brick-and-mortar lender across tier-2 and tier-3 cities, it provides home purchase loans, home construction loans, plot-and-construction loans, balance-transfer and top-up loans, and loans against property to salaried and self-employed customers. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and Elevation Capital. It operates a public marketing website, a customer service portal, a refer-and-earn portal, and an Android mobile app, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Apna
providers.description: Apna is India's leading professional networking and job-search platform, headquartered in Mumbai, India. Job seekers use Apna to search and apply to jobs online for free, join profession and location-based community groups, build a professional profile, and prepare for interviews, while employers post job vacancies and hire quality candidates in as little as 48 hours. Apna is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. At the time of this profile Apna does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this entry captures its public identity and web properties.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Stellapps
providers.description: Stellapps is an end-to-end dairy technology company from Bangalore, India (IIT Madras incubated, founded 2011) that digitizes milk production, milk procurement, and cold-chain management through its SmartMoo full-stack IoT platform. Sensors in milking systems, animal wearables, chilling equipment, and procurement peripherals stream data to the SmartMoo Big Data Cloud for analytics and machine learning serving dairy farmers, cooperatives, and processors, with applications including mooON herd management, smartAMCU and smartCC milk procurement, ConTrak cold-chain monitoring, mooFlow ERP, and mooPay financial services. Stellapps publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; the SmartMoo platform is accessed through hosted applications behind CAS single sign-on.

providers.name: axiTrust
providers.description: axiTrust is a technology and consulting platform for the Indian surety-bond market, connecting IRDAI-licensed insurers, MSMEs, and government procurement bodies. Its platform unifies application processing, underwriting checks, and insurance surety bond issuance, with dashboards for tracking bonds, partners, and claims, plus integrations to financial, legal, banking, and ROC data sources. axiTrust also offers consulting services including discovery workshops, economic analysis comparing sureties to bank guarantees, and adoption support for enterprises and government departments. It is not an insurer or broker; all insurance surety bonds are issued by IRDAI-licensed insurance companies. axiTrust is a fintech backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: TechProcess Payment Services
providers.description: TechProcess Payment Services is an Indian digital-payments pioneer that has been building and operating cloud-based electronic-payment platforms since 2000, when it launched BillJunction.com, India's first electronic bill presentment and payment service. Its payment gateway supports card payments, Net-banking, NACH, NEFT/RTGS, IMPS, UPI and e-wallets for merchants across India. The business is now part of Worldline India (ePayments India), whose merchant checkout product is Paynimo, offering hosted and embeddable checkout, native mobile SDKs, and 20+ e-commerce platform plugins so developers can accept digital payments with a few lines of code. Originally a Battery Ventures portfolio company, it was acquired by Ingenico Group and folded into Worldline.

providers.name: Zopper
providers.description: Zopper is an Indian insurtech platform that combines insurance and technology to deliver end-to-end, embedded insurance distribution for its partners. It builds APIs that let banks, consumer-electronics brands, retailers, e-commerce, travel and fintech platforms embed insurance into their customer journeys, and it manages policy issuance, servicing, claims and compliance across consumer-durables protection, life, health, bancassurance and embedded insurance. Zopper serves 2,500+ brands including Bank of Baroda, Axis Bank, IDFC First Bank, Apple, Samsung, Croma and Vijay Sales, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: DeHaat
providers.description: DeHaat (Green Agrevolution Private Limited) is one of India's largest full-stack agritech platforms, connecting smallholder farmers from "seed to market" through a phygital network of 11,000+ DeHaat Centres and 503 Farmer Producer Organisations across 12+ agrarian states. Founded in 2012 by IIT/IIM alumni, the platform serves 1.8 million+ farmers with agri-inputs (seeds, fertilizers, crop protection), AI-enabled crop advisory in multiple regional languages for 30+ crops, soil analysis, crop-health monitoring, market linkage for harvested produce, and agri-financing. Backed by Prosus Ventures and others, DeHaat operates a franchisee micro-entrepreneur model that raises farmer net incomes 30-50% while making procurement more predictable for buyers. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures; the company publishes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to identity, corporate link-properties, and security posture.

providers.name: Fi Money
providers.description: Fi Money is a Bengaluru, India based money-management application and consumer fintech operated by Epifi Technologies, founded in 2019 by ex-Google Pay (Tez) executives Sujith Narayanan and Sumit Gwalani together with Neeraj Bhope and Prasanna Ranganathan. Fi is not a chartered bank; it delivers a millennial-focused mobile experience layered on top of partner RBI-licensed Federal Bank, providing zero-balance digital savings accounts, a Visa debit card, deposits, mutual funds, Indian and US stocks, EPF tracking, credit cards, personal loans, jump-style automated savings rules ("FIT Rules"), and an AI-powered money assistant. Fi has raised roughly US$169M across multiple rounds from investors including Sequoia Capital India (Peak XV), Ribbit Capital, Temasek, Alpha Wave, and B Capital, and serves Indian retail consumers via iOS and Android apps. There is no classic public REST developer API or partner banking-as-a-service surface; Fi's only developer-facing interface is the Fi MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — a JSON-RPC streaming endpoint at https://mcp.fi.money:8080/mcp/stream that lets users connect their own Fi account to LLM clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini, ChatGPT) and call read-only tools such as fetch_net_worth, fetch_credit_report, fetch_epf_details, fetch_bank_transactions, fetch_mf_transactions, and fetch_stock_transactions to expose their net worth, holdings, EPF balance, credit report, and transactions to AI assistants. A hackathon-friendly mock server (epiFi/fi-mcp-dev, Go) and developer documentation (epiFi/mcp-docs) are published publicly on GitHub.

providers.name: Unacademy
providers.description: Unacademy is a Bangalore-based online learning platform — one of India's largest — offering live classes, courses, study material, and test preparation for competitive exams including UPSC Civil Services, IIT JEE, NEET-UG, SSC, CA Foundation, and CSIR UGC NET, delivered through its web platform and dedicated learner, educator, and parent mobile apps. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Unacademy runs a consumer platform on an internal API (api.unacademy.com) but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Aramya
providers.description: Aramya is a direct-to-consumer (D2C) women's ethnic wear brand from India, operated by DSLR Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and based in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Founded by Ankush Goyal, Aramya sells premium cotton kurtas, kurta sets, bottoms, dresses, co-ord sets, and dupattas with a strong focus on inclusive sizing (XS to 10XL) and affordable, comfortable everyday, office, and occasion wear. The brand runs on a Shopify-based storefront at aramya.in with weekly launches, cash on delivery, and free returns, and has raised multiple rounds (seed, pre-Series A, and an ~INR 80 Cr Series A) co-led by Accel India and Z47 (formerly Matrix Partners India). Aramya is a consumer retail brand and does not publish a public developer API; it does publish an llms.txt describing its shopping surface for AI assistants.

providers.name: LVX (formerly LetsVenture)
providers.description: LVX — formerly LetsVenture — is an India-based private market investing platform founded in 2013 by Shanti Mohan and headquartered in Bengaluru, with teams in Delhi and Mumbai. The platform connects startup founders raising capital with angel investors, family offices and VCs, and has been a SEBI-regulated entity since its Angel AIF was approved in 2018. Its product surface spans LVX start (early-stage angel investing), LVX grow (growth-stage and co-investment deals), LVXschool (private market investor education), LVX Debt (non-dilutive debt financing for startups) and LVX Track (portfolio dashboards), alongside the sister platform trica. The company publicly reports 35K+ startups, 14K+ investors and over Rs 1500 Cr of AIF assets under management. LVX rebranded from LetsVenture in July 2025 and letsventure.com now redirects to lvxventures.com. LVX operates no public developer API program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or SDKs were found, and the platform-backing API at api.lvxventures.com is a private token-authenticated service.

providers.name: Vaya
providers.description: Vaya is an AI-powered Vedic astrology platform from Anuvaya Labs Technologies Pvt Ltd (New Delhi, India) that connects users with classically trained Parashari astrologers for live chat consultations, alongside free tools for Kundli (birth chart), horoscope, dasha, kundli matching, marriage prediction, navamsa, and panchang. Founded by Maahin Puri and Nitesh Kumar Niranjan (previously co-founders of Atlys), Vaya is backed by Accel, Arkam Ventures, and Weekend Fund, and ships as iOS and Android apps with no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Dream11
providers.description: Dream11 is India's largest fantasy sports platform, operated by Sporta Technologies Private Limited and part of the Dream Sports group founded in 2008 by Harsh Jain and Bhavit Sheth and headquartered in Mumbai. Launched as a freemium fantasy game in 2012, it lets 140 million-plus users draft virtual teams and compete in free and paid contests across cricket, football, kabaddi, basketball and hockey, scoring on the real-world performance of the athletes they pick. Dream11 is a consumer, mobile-first product with no public consumer API program; its engineering organization does maintain public open-source infrastructure (Kong rate-limiter and circuit-breaker plugins, the Odin deployment tool) on GitHub and publishes an engineering blog.

providers.name: Aspora
providers.description: Aspora is a cross-border fintech serving the Non-Resident Indian (NRI) diaspora, offering money transfers from the USA, UK, and UAE to India at near-mid-market ("Google") rates, NRE/NRO bank account opening, and digital gold investing, with multi-currency savings, bill payments, and EMI/SIP automation on its roadmap. The company reports over 1 million users moving more than $2 billion, with proactive fraud detection, 256-bit encryption, and funds held at regulated institutions. Formerly known as Vance, Aspora is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Aspora's public web surface (identity, links, and probed domain security).

providers.name: Fundly
providers.description: Fundly is a Mumbai-based fintech platform purpose-built for India's pharmaceutical retail supply chain, offering embedded credit, B2B commerce, and payment solutions to pharma retailers and distributors. Its lending product provides unsecured working capital with interest charged only for the period funds are actually drawn, alongside B2B commerce tooling and payment rails tailored to the cash-flow cycles of the pharma industry. Backed by Accel, Fundly distributes primarily through native iOS and Android apps and works with RBI-regulated lending partners. No public API, developer portal, or technical documentation is currently published; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Onco.com
providers.description: Onco.com is a comprehensive cancer care platform operated by Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd that connects cancer patients across India with oncologists and treatment services. The platform offers priority expert oncology consultations, pan-India cancer medicine delivery at discounted rates, diagnostic testing and imaging, curated treatment packages with negotiated hospital rates, and the CanWin peer support group for survivors and caregivers. Onco.com reports a network of 400+ oncologists and 23+ treatment centers, having served more than 100,000 patients. It also publishes extensive patient-education content covering many cancer types (breast, lung, blood, prostate, colon, and others) through its About Cancer library and blog. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company; the platform is consumer/patient facing and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Pluro
providers.description: Pluro is India's fertility and IVF platform, built as a co-creation model with doctors for patients. It delivers personalised, evidence-based reproductive care through a growing network of 15+ clinics across India, combining advanced clinical science, AI-assisted embryology, standardised treatment protocols, and transparent pricing. Founded by Dr. Bhaskar Shah, Dr. Jaydeep Tank, and Dr. Parikshit Tank, Pluro raised a Rs 125 crore Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners in 2025. It offers IVF/ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, and a range of diagnostic and surgical fertility treatments. Pluro publishes an llms.txt for AI agents but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: BharatPe
providers.description: BharatPe is a New Delhi-based fintech company founded in 2018 by Ashneer Grover and Shashvat Nakrani that provides digital payments and financial services to Indian small and medium businesses. Its merchant stack centers on a single interoperable UPI QR for payment acceptance across all UPI apps, augmented by BharatPe Speaker for voice transaction confirmations, BharatSwipe POS card machines for offline acceptance, BharatPe One (all-in-one POS), bill payments, and a co-branded credit card. On the financing side, BharatPe originates business loans for merchants through partner NBFCs, runs the InvestBharatPe / 12% Club investment platform, operates the PostPe buy-now-pay-later product, and is a co-promoter of Unity Small Finance Bank. The company reports more than ten million merchant partners across 450+ Indian cities and turned profitable in FY24 with roughly INR 1,700 crore in revenue. BharatPe is owned by Resilient Innovations Private Limited; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, sandbox, or OpenAPI surface — its merchant and consumer products are delivered through native Android/iOS apps and an enterprise sales channel for partners.

providers.name: Coverfox
providers.description: Coverfox is one of India's largest online insurance distribution platforms, offering retail insurance products including car, bike, health, and life insurance alongside embedded insurance solutions for lenders, NBFCs, and fintechs. The company partners with 37+ IRDAI-approved insurers to compare, purchase, and manage policies online, and has reached roughly 10 million households across India. Coverfox was backed by Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer program or API at this time.

providers.name: Edme Insurance Brokers
providers.description: Edme Insurance Brokers Ltd (formerly Aditya Birla Insurance Brokers, ABIBL) is an India-based composite insurance broker offering corporate, retail, and reinsurance solutions across 30+ industries including aviation, marine, energy, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, technology, and the BFSI and FMCG sectors. The company provides tailored risk management, employee benefits, and claims advisory services, backed by digital customer portals for policy and claims management and employee benefits. Edme is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Edme publishes no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Policybazaar
providers.description: Policybazaar is India's largest online insurance aggregator and digital marketplace, operated by PB Fintech Ltd. It lets consumers compare, buy and manage insurance across health, term life, motor, travel, investment and corporate lines from a wide panel of insurers, providing quotes, policy issuance, renewals, claims assistance and advisory. Surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Policybazaar publishes a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (no developer/API subdomain, no /.well-known documents, no llms.txt).

providers.name: Shriram Finance
providers.description: Shriram Finance Limited is one of India's largest retail non-banking financial companies (NBFC), with roughly Rs 3.02 lakh crore in assets under management and 3,225 branches nationwide. It offers commercial-vehicle, two-wheeler, used-car, personal, business and gold loans, fixed deposits and fixed investment plans, general and life insurance distribution, Bharat BillPay (BBPS) bill payments, and UPI through its Shriram One app. The company runs consumer web and mobile products but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; a partner portal and a lending-service-provider program serve authorized business partners only.

providers.name: Clinikk
providers.description: Clinikk (Clinikk Health Hub) is a Bangalore, India-based primary healthcare provider offering membership-based access to unlimited doctor consultations, free prescribed medicines and lab tests, 24/7 teleconsultation, and optional group health insurance in partnership with IndusInd General Insurance. Clinikk operates in-person Health Hubs across Bangalore alongside a consumer mobile app, and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Jupiter Money
providers.description: Jupiter Money is a Bengaluru-based Indian digital banking app (neobank) operated by Amica Financial Technologies Private Limited. Founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta, Jupiter delivers a consumer "money app" experience that bundles savings and salary accounts, UPI payments, co-branded credit cards, personal loans, mutual funds, digital gold, fixed and recurring deposits, insurance, and a Jewels rewards program into a single mobile application. Jupiter is itself not a bank — it operates as a fintech marketplace and Loan Service Provider on top of regulated partners. Federal Bank is the primary banking partner for savings, salary, and deposit products, with CSB Bank powering the Edge+ and Edge RuPay credit cards and Federal Bank the Edge Federal VISA card. Lending is provided through partners including Amica Finance Private Limited and Kisetsu Saison Finance, with mutual funds through AIAPL and digital gold through MMTC-PAMP. The product is consumer facing and distributed via the Android and iOS apps; Jupiter does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. All integrations with banks, NBFCs, NPCI/UPI rails, card networks, and depositories are private business-to-business arrangements rather than an open API program.

providers.name: Bolt.Earth
providers.description: Bolt.Earth operates what it describes as India's largest EV charging network, with more than 100,000 charging points deployed across 2,100+ cities. The company sells EV charging hardware (3.3kW smart sockets for 2/3/4-wheelers, AC chargers from 7.4kW to 22kW, and DC fast chargers from 30kW to 240kW) alongside a Charging Management System (CMS) for operators and a consumer mobile app for locating, booking, and paying for charging sessions. Services span site assessment, installation, KYC onboarding, charger activation, remote firmware updates, and 24/7 support for individuals, RWAs, enterprises, fleet operators, hospitality venues, highways, and government agencies. Bolt.Earth is backed by Version One Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an energy-sector company profile. No public developer API portal or OpenAPI definition was found during enrichment.

providers.name: FT Cash
providers.description: FTCash (ftcash) is a Mumbai, India based financial services / fintech company focused on financial inclusion for micro-merchants and small and medium enterprises (SMEs). It provides digital payment acceptance and working-capital business loans to small offline retailers and merchants who are typically underserved by traditional banking, enabling them to accept digital payments and access short-term credit. FTCash was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global (500 Startups) and added to the API Evangelist network. At this time FTCash operates a public marketing website but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile is limited to verified company identity plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Transbnk
providers.description: TransBnk — rebranded as TBX — is an Indian open-finance and transaction-banking infrastructure company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Mumbai. It gives banks, enterprises, fintechs, corporates, and NBFCs the platforms, APIs, and connected workflows behind corporate banking: mandate management, escrow flows, virtual accounts, reconciliation, lending acceleration, and cash and treasury management. TransBnk reports partnerships with 25+ banks, 200+ APIs extended, 100+ BFSI clients, and 50M+ transactions processed. Products include TxB Hub (transaction banking), TrustHub (core banking and escrow), and the API Hub integration surface. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, 8i Ventures, and Accion Venture Lab.

providers.name: Onsitego
providers.description: Onsitego is a Mumbai-based Indian consumer device-protection company that sells extended warranty, accidental and liquid damage protection, and repair and maintenance (AMC) plans for consumer electronics and home appliances including mobile phones, laptops, televisions, refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners. Sold at point of sale through 10,000+ retail stores and serviced via 3,300+ service centers, the company reports 2.5+ crore (25M+) customers and lets buyers activate coverage, manage devices and plans, and request service online. Onsitego is a portfolio company of Accel. No public developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Policy Bazaar
providers.description: Policybazaar is India's largest online insurance aggregator and marketplace, operated by PB Fintech Limited (publicly listed on the NSE and BSE) and headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. Founded in 2008 by Yashish Dahiya, Alok Bansal, and Avaneesh Nirjar, it is an IRDAI-licensed insurance web aggregator and broker that lets consumers compare, buy, and manage policies across life, term, health, motor (car and bike), travel, and investment (ULIP and guaranteed-return) products from more than fifty partner insurers. The platform provides quote comparison, online purchase, claims assistance, and renewal management, and is a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital. Policybazaar does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Livspace
providers.description: Livspace is India's largest home interior design and renovation company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Bangalore. It runs an end-to-end, technology-driven interiors platform: free design consultation, in-browser 3D visualisation, factory-made modular products (kitchens, wardrobes, storage), and managed on-site installation, backed by a lifetime warranty on modular products. Livspace serves 125+ cities across India through 100+ Experience Centres and a network of interior designers, covering full-home interiors, modular kitchens, false ceilings, flooring, painting and related fit-out services. It is a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company. This profile currently exposes no public developer API or SDK surface; enrichment captured its public security, well-known, and llms.txt surfaces.

providers.name: MediBuddy (fka DocsApp)
providers.description: MediBuddy (formerly DocsApp) is India's largest digital healthcare platform, operated by Phasorz Technologies Private Limited and founded in 2013 by Satish Kannan and Enbasekar Dinadayalane. Launched as DocsApp in 2015 for online doctor consultations, it merged with and rebranded to MediBuddy in June 2020. The consumer platform delivers teleconsultations (chat, video, voice) across 20+ specialties, at-home lab-test bookings, online medicine delivery covering 95%+ of Indian pin codes, and health checks. It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Quadria Capital and Rebright Partners. No public developer / API program was found; product access is via the consumer web and mobile apps.

providers.name: Sukino
providers.description: Sukino Healthcare is a Bangalore, India-based continuum-of-care provider specializing in post-hospitalization recovery, rehabilitation, and transitional care for seniors and patients with chronic and neurological conditions. Founded by Rajinish Menon, it operates in-patient continuum care centers alongside home healthcare services, covering neuro, stroke, and knee-replacement rehabilitation, transitional care, and palliative care. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, Sukino is a healthcare services operator and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification at this time; this profile captures its identity and web presence for network discovery.

providers.name: BRND.ME
providers.description: BRND.ME (legally Mensa Brand Technologies Private Limited) is an India-based house-of-brands company that acquires, builds, and scales digital-first consumer brands across Health, Wellness, Lifestyle, Fashion, Party & Celebration, and Home Decor. Founded by Ananth Narayanan and backed by Accel, the company combines technology, data insight, and centralized operations to grow market-leading D2C brands from India for global customers. Its portfolio includes brands such as Majestic Pure, Botanic Hearth, Dennis Lingo, House of Ishin, and MyFitness. This is a company/provider profile in the API Evangelist network; BRND.ME operates a corporate marketing presence and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Pratilipi
providers.description: Pratilipi is India's largest digital storytelling platform, democratizing story creation and consumption across languages, formats, and boundaries. Built by Nasadiya Technologies Private Limited and headquartered in Bangalore, it lets more than 300,000 self-published writers reach roughly 25 million monthly readers across twelve Indian languages (Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Urdu, and Odia). The ecosystem spans Pratilipi Literature, Pratilipi FM (audio books, podcasts, and folk songs), Pratilipi Comics (the largest Hindi online comic platform), Westland Publications, and IVM Podcasts, carrying a story "from someone's draft to someone's screen." Pratilipi does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Tejas Networks India
providers.description: Tejas Networks is a Bengaluru, India-based optical and data networking products company that designs, develops and manufactures telecom networking equipment for communications service providers, internet and cable operators, utilities, defence and government agencies worldwide. Its portfolio spans optical transport (DWDM/OTN), packet transport, broadband access (GPON/fiber) and wireless (4G/5G radio access) systems deployed across more than 75 countries. The company is publicly listed in India (NSE/BSE TEJASNET) and is majority owned by the Tata Group; Battery Ventures was an early institutional investor. Tejas Networks is a hardware and network-infrastructure vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal or SDK program.

providers.name: FirstCry
providers.description: FirstCry (operated by Brainbees Solutions Ltd) is India's largest omnichannel retailer of baby, kids, and maternity products, founded in 2010 by Supam Maheshwari and Amitava Saha and headquartered in Pune, India. It sells apparel, footwear, toys, diapers, feeding and nursery gear, and personal-care products across its website, mobile apps, and a large network of physical stores, alongside in-house brands such as BabyHug. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and listed publicly on the NSE and BSE in 2024. FirstCry publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web, policy, and security-disclosure surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Loop Health
providers.description: Loop Health is an India-based health assurance and group insurance company, founded in 2018 by Mayank Kale and Amrit Singh and headquartered in Pune. It combines traditional group hospitalization insurance with unlimited primary care, telemedicine, wellness programs, mental-health counseling, and an Employee Assistance Program, delivered to employers and their teams through asset-light clinics and a member app. Backed by General Catalyst, Elevation Capital and Y Combinator, Loop serves 1,250+ companies and 950,000+ members across India. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Loop Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: HomeLane
providers.description: HomeLane is an Indian end-to-end interior design company that delivers customized home interiors — modular kitchens, wardrobes, storage, bedroom, living room, bathroom, and home-office designs — pairing in-house digital design and 3D visualization tools with material selection and professional installation, backed by a 45-day delivery guarantee on end-to-end modular interiors. Founded in Bangalore and backed by Accel, HomeLane operates across major Indian cities through design studios, a franchise/partner network, and a customer mobile app. HomeLane currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its digital, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Spinny
providers.description: Spinny (Valuedrive Technologies Ltd.) is an India-based online marketplace for buying and selling used cars. Every Spinny Assured car undergoes a 200-point quality check and comes with a 1-year warranty, a 5-day money-back guarantee, and hassle-free RC ownership transfer. The platform also offers instant online car valuation, doorstep evaluation, used-car finance and EMI, car insurance, RC transfer, scrap-car service, e-Challan and RTO lookups, servicing, the Spinny Max luxury tier, and a Partners auction platform for dealers. Backed by Accel and General Catalyst. Spinny publishes a consumer web experience and an llms.txt for AI agents but does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Stanza Living
providers.description: Stanza Living is one of India's largest managed accommodation and co-living platforms, founded in 2017 by IIM-Ahmedabad alumni Anindya Dutta and Sandeep Dalmia and headquartered in Gurugram. It provides professionally managed, fully furnished, brokerage-free residences — student housing, co-living for working professionals, and managed apartments — across 24+ Indian cities, operating 450+ residences and more than 70,000 beds under the promise of "your second home in a new city." The company is backed by investors including Accel, Falcon Edge, Sequoia Capital and Matrix Partners. Stanza Living operates as a consumer web and mobile brand for discovering, booking and living in managed accommodation, and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: GrowXCD
providers.description: GrowXCD (GrowXCD Finance Private Limited) is an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) headquartered in Chennai, India, focused on accelerating business growth for the small businesses and self-employed customers that form the backbone of India's economy. Its lending products include Grow Shubam small-ticket mortgage loans, Loan Against Property (LAP) secured lending, and unsecured loans up to Rs 25 lakh with tenures of 12 to 60 months, delivered through a minimal-documentation digital process with swift approvals and repayment via eMandate or NACH auto-debit. GrowXCD is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. It publishes a consumer website and statutory policy documents but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: Junglee Games
providers.description: Junglee Games is a skill-based online gaming company founded in 2012 by Ankush Gera, operating as an independent subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, which acquired a majority stake in 2021 in a deal valuing the company at more than $440 million. Headquartered in Gurugram with a studio in Bengaluru, the company builds and operates consumer real-money and casual gaming apps for a base of over 150 million users, with flagship titles including Junglee Rummy, the Howzat fantasy cricket and football platform, Carrom Stars, and Junglee Poker. The company positions trust, safety, and fairness as engineering priorities. Junglee Games is a consumer gaming provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documented API program; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and probed security posture for the API Evangelist network. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Rentomojo
providers.description: Rentomojo is India's largest tech-driven, full-stack direct-to-consumer furniture and appliance rental platform, converting ownership into flexible monthly subscriptions. Customers rent beds, sofas, wardrobes, refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, water purifiers and other home essentials on plans from roughly three to thirty-six months, with delivery, installation, maintenance, relocation and upgrades handled in-house. Per its March 2026 draft red herring prospectus the company operates across 22 Indian cities with 227,511 live subscribers and 1,688 in-house technicians, carpenters and painters. Backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; this pass found no public developer API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: High Mark Credit Information Services
providers.description: High Mark Credit Information Services (now operating as CRIF High Mark) is one of India's four RBI-licensed credit bureaus, headquartered in Mumbai. It maintains credit information on retail, microfinance, and commercial borrowers, and delivers credit reports, bureau scores, analytics, portfolio monitoring, fraud-detection, and origination-decisioning solutions to banks, NBFCs, microfinance institutions, insurers, and telecom providers. The bureau is best known for its microfinance credit information services and pan-India retail and commercial credit databases. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer portal or API specification, so this profile captures company identity and domain security posture only.

providers.name: Jar
providers.description: Jar is a Bengaluru-based fintech company operating India's first micro-savings app, enabling tens of millions of Indians to save in 24K digital gold from as little as ₹10. The app supports daily, weekly, monthly, and instant savings mechanisms, plus a round-up feature that automatically invests spare change from everyday transactions into 99.5%+ pure digital gold held in insured vaults. Founded in 2021 by Nishchay AG (CEO) and Misbah Ashraf (CPO) under Changejar Technologies Private Limited, Jar has grown to 50+ million registered users across 12,000+ Indian zip codes. The company recently vertically integrated its gold operations, moving away from a third-party distribution model to purchase, store, and manage gold directly. Jar partners with Brink's for global custody, ICICI Lombard for insurance, Vistra as independent trustee, and BDO as statutory auditor. Adjacent products include Nek, a direct-to-consumer gold and silver jewellery brand sold via shopnek.com. Jar reached profitability in 2025 after backing from Tiger Global, Arkam Ventures, Rainfall Ventures, Yes VC, and others at a $300M+ valuation, and is preparing for an IPO. There is no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program — Jar is a B2C consumer mobile app distributed exclusively through Apple App Store and Google Play.

providers.name: Venwiz
providers.description: Venwiz is a Bengaluru, India based B2B digital platform for the procurement of industrial and infrastructural project services, covering both CapEx and MRO requirements for the manufacturing sector. Founded in 2020 by Rajesh Reddy and Sandesh Paturi, it operates a marketplace that connects industrial buyers with a verified, pan-India database of service vendors, adding vendor discovery, order expediting, project management tooling and vendor intelligence on top. Backed by Accel and other investors (~$11.4M raised), Venwiz digitises what has traditionally been an offline, relationship-driven industrial services procurement process. No public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this enrichment pass; the public presence is a marketing/content website plus a login-gated application.

providers.name: Book My Show
providers.description: BookMyShow (Bigtree Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.) is India's premier online entertainment ticketing platform, serving as a centralized hub for discovering and booking movies, live music festivals, comedy, theatre, sports, activities, and Video-on-Demand (VOD) streaming. For enterprise partners and event organizers it also provides venue management software, box-office point-of-sale solutions, corporate vouchers, gift cards, and end-to-end event production capabilities. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel; enriched by the enrichment pipeline. No public developer API or portal was found, but BookMyShow publishes an agent-facing llms.txt describing its consumer inventory hubs and B2B services.

providers.name: Physics Wallah
providers.description: Physics Wallah (PW) is India's leading affordable education technology platform, offering live and recorded courses, test series, notes, and doubt-solving for competitive exams (IIT JEE, NEET, GATE, UPSC), government job preparation (SSC, Banking, Railways, Defence), school boards (CBSE, ICSE, and regional boards), and professional certifications (CA, CS, CFA, ACCA). Beyond its flagship pw.live learning app it operates PW Skills for professional upskilling, PW Store for books and study material, CuriousJr for younger grades, and 100+ offline Vidyapeeth and Pathshala centres across 175+ cities. Physics Wallah reached unicorn status in 2022 and serves tens of millions of students. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Physics Wallah does not publish an official public developer portal or API program; the company's public technology footprint is a set of open-source infrastructure libraries under its tech-pw GitHub org.

providers.name: Portea
providers.description: Portea Medical is India's leading home healthcare provider, delivering clinical care to patients at home across 40+ cities. Services include physiotherapy, nursing care, doctor consultations, medical equipment rental, trained attendants, diagnostic and lab tests, counselling, and specialized programs for eldercare, mother and baby care, diabetes, critical care, and vaccination. Portea was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer home-healthcare operator it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Indian Energy Exchange
providers.description: Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) is India's largest electricity trading platform, operating a nationwide automated exchange for the physical delivery of electricity, renewable energy, and certificates. IEX runs Day-Ahead, Real-Time, Term-Ahead, Renewable Energy Certificate and Energy Saving Certificate market segments, matching buy and sell bids across a member network of distribution utilities, industrial and commercial consumers, and power generators. For members with sophisticated trading needs IEX offers a members-only trading API (currently for the iDAM and RTM segments) supporting order placement, trade-data retrieval and real-time monitoring for automated and high-frequency trading; access is provisioned to registered members rather than published as a public developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Agrostar
providers.description: AgroStar (Ulink Agritech Private Ltd) is a leading Indian agri-tech company on a mission to help farmers grow more and earn more, sustainably. Founded in Pune, it operates India's largest digital farmer network and agri-inputs platform, serving millions of farmers across Gujarat, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh through its Kisan (AgriDoctor) mobile app. AgroStar builds a connected ecosystem across the agricultural value chain — farm advisory, quality agri-inputs, omnichannel retail access and global market linkages — backed by data and agronomy expertise, with a focus on climate-smart agriculture, water conservation and reducing food waste. It is a portfolio company of Accel. AgroStar's public corporate site is Wix-powered and exposes a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint plus an /llms.txt for agentic AI access to public site content; it does not publish a developer-facing product API.

providers.name: APAC Financial Services
providers.description: APAC Financial Services (Apacfin) is a Mumbai-based, Reserve Bank of India registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) that provides customized MSME business loans to underbanked and underserved micro, small, and medium enterprises across India. APAC offers tech-enabled, largely paperless digital onboarding, quick disbursal with minimal documentation, and a mobile app (APACM) for loan tracking, EMI payments, and service requests. The lender reports roughly Rs 2,479 Crore of assets under management across 226 branches in six states, serving more than 52,000 customers, and carries an ICRA A (Stable) credit rating. APAC is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published; customer and partner interaction is via the mobile app and hosted customer/complaint portals.

providers.name: Arivihan
providers.description: Arivihan is an Indian EdTech company operating an AI-based, fully automated online learning platform that gives each K-12 school student a personalized "tutor in their pocket." It targets low- and middle-income families and students in Tier 2+ cities, delivering interactive, personalized lectures and doubt resolution in vernacular languages at roughly 10% of typical coaching fees. Products include the DoubtBuzzter mobile app and the tutor-prod / InstantGuru doubt-resolution web platform. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and prosus-ventures. No public API or developer surface was found during enrichment; this remains a consumer-facing product profile.

providers.name: Brick&Bolt
providers.description: Brick&Bolt (bricknbolt.com) is a Bangalore-based, tech-enabled home and commercial construction marketplace that delivers end-to-end design-to-build services across major Indian cities including Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi NCR, and Mysuru. The company connects homeowners with vetted contractors and manages projects through its QASCON quality system (470+ quality checks), an ESCROW-secured payment model that releases funds only as milestones complete, transparent quotations, and consumer and professional mobile apps for real-time project tracking. Backed by Accel, Brick&Bolt has delivered thousands of homes and was named to Forbes Asia's "100 to Watch" list. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Brick&Bolt operates a consumer construction platform and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Cashify
providers.description: Cashify is an Indian re-commerce platform for buying, selling, and repairing used and refurbished consumer electronics — smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other gadgets. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gurugram, the company provides instant online price quotes, free doorstep pickup with on-the-spot payment for devices sold to it, and sells certified refurbished devices backed by warranty. Alongside its consumer website and mobile apps, Cashify operates a network of physical retail stores across India, runs device repair services, and offers a partner program for retailers. It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners among other investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead and has been enriched with identity and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: CrownIT
providers.description: CrownIT (Crownit.in) is India's online market-research and consumer-insights platform, now acquired by Ipsos, the world's leading market research company. Operating as a full-stack agency, Crownit conducts online surveys and tracks purchase and consumption behavior via shopping bills and product photos submitted through its mobile app, applying machine learning and big-data analytics to deliver fast, accurate and comprehensive consumer insights to over 200 brands and enterprises across 40+ Indian cities. Backed by Accel and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio company profile; Crownit runs a consumer rewards and survey application rather than a public developer API, so this profile carries company identity only and has no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API artifacts.

providers.name: Curefoods
providers.description: Curefoods is a Bengaluru-based multi-brand cloud kitchen and quick-service restaurant company founded in 2020 that builds and operates iconic Indian food brands. As of March 2025 it runs roughly 502 outlets across India (about 281 cloud kitchens, 99 kiosks, and 122 restaurants) under a house-of-brands model including Kitchens of EatFit, Sharief Bhai, Olio Pizza, Nomad Pizza, Arambam, CakeZone, Frozen Bottle, and Krispy Kreme. Backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, and Iron Pillar, the company crossed roughly Rs 746 crore in FY25 revenue and has received SEBI approval for an IPO. Curefoods is a consumer food operator with no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and carries only identity, domain-security, and public-property signals.

providers.name: Finova Capital
providers.description: Finova Capital is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) licensed by the Reserve Bank of India, founded in 2015 by Mohit Sahney and Sunita Sahney and headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan. It provides secured lending to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and self-employed customers across India, including MSME business loans, home loans, working capital and machinery loans, and personal loans, all secured against immovable property. Operating across 17 states through 450+ branches, Finova Capital is backed by investors including Peak XV Partners, Norwest Venture Partners, Faering Capital, Maj Invest, Sofina Ventures, Avataar Ventures and Madison India Capital. The company holds a Certificate of Registration issued by the RBI under Section 45-IA of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934. This is a financial-services provider with a public marketing and investor-relations website; it does not currently expose a public developer API surface.

providers.name: HomeFirst
providers.description: HomeFirst (Home First Finance Company India Limited) is an affordable-housing finance company headquartered in Mumbai, India, that provides home loans, self-construction and resale loans, loans against property, shop loans, and renovation/top-up loans to first-time and lower- to middle-income home buyers across India, marketing itself as "India's Home Loan Expert" with approval within 48 hours. It is a technology-led lender operating consumer-facing customer and connector portals and mobile apps, and is a publicly listed company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. It was surfaced as a Bessemer portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time, so this profile captures its public web/identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: HouseEazy
providers.description: HouseEazy is an Indian proptech startup, founded in 2021 by Tarun Sainani and Deepak Bhatia, that runs a full-stack platform for buying and selling ready-to-move, pre-owned residential homes across the Delhi NCR region (Noida, Ghaziabad, and Gurugram). It uses an AI/ML-based pricing algorithm built on over two million on-ground data points — registry records, market trends, and recent transactions — to price properties instantly, then pairs that with 3D walkthroughs, drone imagery, and virtual staging to make resale transactions fast, transparent, and secure. HouseEazy also offers LoanEazy home financing and a channel-partner program, and is backed by Accel, Antler, and DTU-IIF. It is a consumer-facing web application and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: IKF Finance
providers.description: IKF Finance Limited is an India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) that has provided asset financing for more than 35 years through a network of 300+ branches pan-India, serving over one lakh customers. Its lending products include commercial vehicle loans, construction equipment loans, tractor loans, car and MUV loans, and MSME and business loans, with home loans offered through the affiliated IKF Home Finance entity. Operating under the tagline "Powering Progress with Prompt Financing," the company focuses on prompt, accessible credit for transport operators, small businesses, and individuals across India. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched with public identity, legal, and domain-security signals; IKF Finance publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Meragi
providers.description: Meragi is an Indian wedding planning and execution platform for city and destination weddings, offering a plug-and-play alternative to bare-shell venues. It coordinates venue discovery, decor design (10,000+ options), catering, photography, vendor management, and multi-event logistics across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Goa, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, and Udaipur. Backed by Accel, the company runs a consumer-facing web presence with no public developer, API, or integration surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Oolka
providers.description: Oolka is a Bangalore-based consumer fintech that helps people in India check, monitor, and improve their credit scores. Its mobile app provides free bureau-integrated credit-score checks (Experian), a Credit Builder for users with no prior credit history, EMI and bill payments with cashback via Bharat Bill Pay (the RBI-NPCI initiative), AI-guided insights on credit utilization and payment timing, and assistance disputing incorrect credit-report entries. Oolka operates as a co-branded financial-product partner working with banks and financial institutions. It is a consumer-facing mobile application and does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK surface.

providers.name: Rapido
providers.description: Rapido is an Indian on-demand urban mobility platform that connects riders with independent driver-partners (called "Captains") for bike taxis, auto rickshaws, and cabs through its consumer and Captain mobile apps. Founded in Bengaluru and backed by Accel, Rapido operates across hundreds of Indian cities and has expanded into parcel delivery and corporate mobility. As of this enrichment pass Rapido exposes only a consumer-facing web and app surface — no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification was found. This profile captures the company identity, its published policy and content pages, and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Seekho
providers.description: Seekho (operated by Keyaro Edutech Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, India) is a consumer edutainment mobile application delivering short-form learning videos across 50+ categories including stock market investing, spoken English, YouTube monetization, business, cooking, and government-procedure (sarkari) guidance. The platform reports 10 crore+ downloads, 40+ lakh learners, 10,000+ videos, and 250+ verified mentors, and is distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass, Seekho publishes a consumer marketing site, a blog, and a creator program but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API surface.

providers.name: Sharechat
providers.description: ShareChat (Mohalla Tech Pvt. Ltd.) is an Indian social media company that operates the regional-language social network ShareChat and the short-video entertainment app Moj. The platform lets users across 15+ Indian languages share posts, images, videos, shayari, quotes, and trending content through personalized feeds. ShareChat monetizes through a self-serve advertising platform (ShareChat Ads) offering campaign management, audience targeting, and brand partnerships across its social and short-video surfaces. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and other investors, the company is one of the largest homegrown social platforms in India. As of this profile, ShareChat exposes consumer apps and a self-serve ad manager but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or programmatic API surface.

providers.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd
providers.description: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd (JISL) is a global agri-industrial conglomerate headquartered in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, India, and is widely cited as the world's largest micro-irrigation company. Founded in 1963 by Padma Shri recipient Bhavarlal Jain under the slogan "More Crop Per Drop," the company manufactures drip and sprinkler irrigation systems, PVC/HDPE/PP and plumbing piping, rigid and foam plastic sheets, solar pumping and photovoltaic systems, tissue-culture planting material, greenhouses and protected cultivation, and processed foods. JISL operates 33 manufacturing bases across four continents, serves 126+ countries through 11,000+ dealers, is listed on the BSE and NSE, and reports turnover exceeding USD 1.2 billion. The company publishes a structured llms.txt for AI crawlers but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: OurHealthMate
providers.description: OurHealthMate was an Indian digital health-tech startup (a 500 Global / 500 Startups portfolio company) that let non-resident Indians book medical appointments, health checkups, and lab tests at hospitals and clinics across India on behalf of family members. The ourhealthmate.com domain now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to myfitnesswallet.com, a corporate wellness platform operating in India and Singapore that delivers employee wellness programs, telemedicine, health risk assessments, health screenings, and mental-wellness services to enterprise clients. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface could be found for either brand as of this enrichment pass; this remains an identity-only company profile in the API Evangelist network with no API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Pronto
providers.description: Pronto is an on-demand and subscription-based house-help marketplace operating across 11 Indian cities (including Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi, Hyderabad, and Pune). It connects urban homes with trained, background-verified Pronto Professionals for everyday household chores such as cleaning, laundry, kitchen prep, bathroom care, ironing, dusting, and window cleaning. Customers book in the Pronto mobile app (iOS and Android) for instant (a Pro in ~15 minutes), scheduled, or recurring service, and pay in-app; the withpronto.com website is the marketing surface while the booking flow runs in the app. Pronto is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; the only machine-readable surface is a provider-published llms.txt.

providers.name: Jobvetta
providers.description: Jobvetta is a jobs API for India — live openings gathered and checked against official employer sources, exposed as a REST API and a hosted MCP server that share one key. Search by keyword, Indian city or state, and posting age; fetch full structured detail for a single job. It is India-only by design: non-Indian locations return no results. The MCP server answers tools/list without credentials, so an agent can discover the two tools before signing up, and installation is a single documented `claude mcp add` command. Free during early access, with a shared limit of 50 tool calls per day and up to 20 jobs per search across both surfaces.

providers.name: Khatabook
providers.description: Khatabook is a Bengaluru, India-based fintech company building a mobile-first digital ledger ("bahi khata") and business management platform for India's 6.3 crore-strong MSME sector. Founded in 2018 by Ravish Naresh, Vaibhav Kalpe, Dhanesh Kumar, and Jaideep Poonia, its flagship Khatabook Android app lets shopkeepers and small merchants record credit transactions ("udhaar"), send free WhatsApp/SMS payment reminders, collect payments via UPI and QR codes, and generate ledger statements — replacing the paper notebook ("khata") historically used across Indian retail. The app has been downloaded over 50 million times and is offered in 13+ Indian languages. Khatabook's portfolio also includes Cashbook (cash-in/cash-out tracking), Pagarkhata/Pagarbook (staff attendance and salary management), Biz Analyst (Tally mobility for accountants, acquired in 2021 for ~$10M), and a suite of GST, EMI, income tax, payroll, and loan calculators. The company has raised roughly $190M across seed through Series C from Sequoia Capital, Tencent, DST Global, GGV Capital, Y Combinator, B Capital, Moore Strategic Ventures, and angels including MS Dhoni, valuing it around $600M. Khatabook monetizes via SMB lending tie-ups, premium business tools, and adjacent fintech distribution. The Khatabook GitHub organization (verified, owns khatabook.com) exists but has no public repositories, and the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI spec, or partner program — its surface is a consumer/SMB mobile app rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Data Sutram
providers.description: Data Sutram is an enterprise AI trust platform for the financial services sector, using external and alternative data intelligence plus agentic workflows to power fraud detection, identity and address verification, credit assessment, and collections. Its products - Trust (fraud and trust scoring), Auth (authentication and verification), and Echo (collections intelligence) - are applied across the customer lifecycle from acquisition and onboarding through portfolio monitoring and debt recovery. Data Sutram serves leading Indian banks and fintechs including HDFC, Axis, ICICI, Kotak, IndusInd, Jupiter, Navi, and Fibe, and maintains ISO 27001, ISO 27018, and SOC 2 certifications along with DPDP compliance. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and is also backed by B Capital.

providers.name: Magicpin
providers.description: Magicpin (operated by Samast Technologies Private Limited) is India's hyperlocal savings and discovery platform, connecting consumers with deals, cashback, and vouchers across restaurants, food delivery, fashion, grocery, beauty, fitness, and electronics merchants in cities throughout India. The company operates a consumer savings app alongside a merchant/brands portal and corporate voucher solutions. As of this enrichment pass Magicpin publishes a consumer web and mobile experience plus partner and brand onboarding portals, but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer documentation.

providers.name: ApniBus
providers.description: ApniBus is an India-based online bus ticket booking platform that lets travelers search routes, compare operators, select seats, and pay for tickets across government and private bus services. It positions itself as a leading Indian bus-booking marketplace and an official RSRTC (Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation) booking partner, aggregating over one lakh bus services across thousands of routes. The consumer experience spans a website and Android/iOS apps, with UPI, cards, net banking, and wallet payments, instant e-ticket / m-ticket confirmation, live bus tracking, and easy cancellation. ApniBus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it publishes no public developer or API program at this time.

providers.name: Bachatt
providers.description: Bachatt is a daily savings and investments mobile app operated by Trusave Fintech Private Limited, designed for India's underserved and self-employed population. As an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor, Bachatt lets users save from as little as INR 100/day and invest in liquid mutual funds (Insta Fund) with instant withdrawal, curated mutual fund baskets (Bachatt Wealth), gold and silver mutual funds, fixed deposits, and access instant personal and business loans (Insta Loans) up to INR 5 lakhs. The company partners with major AMCs including SBI, ICICI Prudential, Axis, and HDFC and delivers everything through a single UPI-powered mobile application on Android and iOS. Bachatt is backed by Accel. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Bachatt is a consumer fintech app and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Hotelogix
providers.description: Hotelogix is a cloud-based hotel property management system (PMS) headquartered in Noida, India, serving more than 12,000 independent hotels, groups, chains, and resorts across 100+ countries since 2008. The platform provides front desk management, reservations, point-of-sale, housekeeping, revenue management, multi-property and group management, a web booking engine, a guest service mobile app, and an integrated channel manager that distributes inventory to OTAs and GDS. Hotelogix exposes a partner Web API (HAPI) at developer.hotelogix.net that uses XML POST over HTTP rather than REST/JSON, enabling channel managers, payment gateways, accounting systems, CRMs, loyalty programs, door locks, ID scanners, and in-room devices to integrate with the PMS. Documentation is split into Web (booking engine), Admin, and Frontdesk surfaces. There is no public OpenAPI specification, no public SDK, and no public GitHub org content; partner access and credentials are granted on request through the Hotelogix support and partnership teams. Revenue model is SaaS subscriptions per hotel/room along with an integration marketplace ecosystem.

providers.name: Openhouse
providers.description: Openhouse is a network of neighborhood children's learning centres in Bangalore and Kolkata, India, describing itself as a "Third Space" for children — neither home nor school, but a sanctuary for curiosity. It runs preschool programs for ages 1-6, a Parent-Toddler Club for ages 1-3, and Excel extracurriculars (robotics, public speaking, music, art and design) for ages 3-5+, built around a learning-by-doing philosophy. The consumer-facing website (openhouse.school, formerly openhouse.study) is a marketing and enrollment surface; the only network-visible technical surface is a private app backend health endpoint at api.openhouse.study. Openhouse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Powerup Money
providers.description: PowerUp Money is an India-based mutual fund advisory app that helps retail investors select, monitor, and rebalance their mutual fund portfolios. It is operated by a SEBI-registered Investment Advisor (RIA No. INA000019798) and BSE member (IA-BSE Membership No. 2465), and describes itself as "India's trusted Mutual Fund Advisory App" serving 900,000+ investors. Consumer-facing features include portfolio performance analysis, fund recommendations (start/pause/exit SIP guidance), monthly portfolio reports, and Elite membership tools such as Power Rank fund selection, Rank Trends monitoring, and Power Rebalancing for tax-efficient quarterly adjustments. It is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company.

providers.name: Rupeek
providers.description: Rupeek is an asset-backed online gold loan company operating across India, enabling customers to borrow money by pledging gold jewelry as collateral. Its products include gold loans (from around 30,000 up to 1.5 crore rupees), gold loan balance transfers, the Rupeek Gold Card, part/full gold release, and an online repayment portal. The company partners with banks such as Federal Bank, Indian Bank, and South Indian Bank, offers 100% insurance coverage via New India Assurance, and delivers its consumer experience primarily through its website and highly-rated mobile app. It is ISO 27001 certified. Rupeek is a consumer fintech surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and GGV Capital; it publishes no public developer API surface, so this profile is an identity-only company record.

providers.name: Snowman
providers.description: Snowman Logistics is an Indian integrated cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics company headquartered in Bengaluru, providing refrigerated (frozen and chilled) warehousing, cold storage, and distribution services across India. It serves frozen and chilled foods, dairy, seafood, quick-service restaurants, pharmaceuticals, and other perishables through a national network of temperature-controlled warehouses and a refrigerated transportation fleet. The company is publicly listed on Indian exchanges and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes a marketing/corporate website (snowman.in) but exposes no public developer, API, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Sulekha
