providers.description: Sulekha is an online local-services marketplace and classifieds platform serving Indian communities in the United States and Canada (us.sulekha.com) as well as its origin market in India (sulekha.com). It connects consumers with local service providers across housing and rentals, events and concert tickets, jobs, care services (nannies, eldercare, housekeeping), real estate, beauty, photography, immigration, astrology, travel and IT training. Sulekha operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace rather than an API producer; no public developer portal, API reference, or programmatic integration surface is published. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Swish
providers.description: Swish (operated by Munchmart Technologies Private Limited) is a Bengaluru-based quick-commerce food delivery startup founded in 2024 that promises meals at your door in ten minutes. It runs a full-stack, vertically integrated model — owning its neighbourhood cloud kitchens ("delight centres"), sourcing and supply chain, proprietary ordering/routing technology, and its own last-mile delivery fleet — operating dense hyperlocal clusters of roughly 1.5–2 km. The company focuses on frequent, lower-ticket occasions such as breakfast, snacks, and late-night meals, and reports around 20,000 orders a day across Bengaluru micro-markets. Swish raised a $38M Series B led by Hara Global and Bain Capital Ventures with participation from Accel, valuing it at $139M post-money and bringing total funding to about $54M. Swish is a consumer mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: RedWing Aerospace Laboratories
providers.description: RedWing Aerospace Laboratories (RedWing Labs, operated by Kitemaps AMS Pvt Ltd) is a Bangalore, India based, Techstars-backed company that designs, develops and deploys fully autonomous drones to transform logistics supply chains. It offers a fleet of long-range, urban and medium-range delivery aircraft plus an operations software suite, and runs an autonomous four-step delivery flow (order, handoff to flight operations, proof of delivery, return to hub) used to move healthcare products, food and other goods within the hour. The company reports operational milestones including 145,930+ kilometers flown and thousands of deliveries completed. RedWing does not publish a first-party developer API; its public agent surface is the platform-provided Wix Site MCP endpoint advertised in its llms.txt.

providers.name: CarWale
providers.description: CarWale is an Indian automotive marketplace and part of CarTrade Tech Limited, connecting car buyers with new-car dealers and used-car sellers across 1,500+ cities in India. The consumer platform offers new and used vehicle listings, accurate on-road pricing sourced directly from dealers, car valuation and sell-car tools, side-by-side comparisons, expert reviews and first-drive reports, and automotive news and video content. CarWale reports over 34 million monthly unique visitors and operates alongside sister brands including BikeWale, CarTrade, CarWale abSure, Mobility Outlook, and Adroit Auto. CarWale does not currently publish a public developer portal or API; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: FabHotels
providers.description: FabHotels is an Indian branded-budget hotel chain and online booking platform, founded in 2014 by Vaibhav Aggarwal and Adarsh Manpuria and headquartered in Gurugram. It operates a network of 1500+ standardized economy hotels across 80+ cities under the FabHotel, FabHotel Prime, and Via brands, with quality-controlled amenities such as free WiFi, air conditioning, and 24/7 security. Consumers book stays through the FabHotels website and its iOS and Android apps; the company also runs a franchise program for property owners and corporate-stay offerings, and is backed by Accel and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface is advertised — this remains a business-to-consumer travel brand rather than an API provider.

providers.name: First Club
providers.description: FirstClub is a member-exclusive quick-commerce grocery platform operating in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, India, delivering curated, quality-inspected groceries in as little as 30 minutes from physical "ClubHouses" rather than traditional dark stores. The company targets India's top-tier consumers with only trusted, tasted, and tested products, screening out a published list of banned ingredients across categories including fruits and vegetables, dairy and eggs, bakery, staples, kids nutrition, packaged foods, snacks and beverages, health supplements, and cleaning essentials. FirstClub also offers a subscription model, "FirstClub Mornings." Founded by ex-Flipkart executive Ayyappan R, the company is backed by Accel and RTP Global. It surfaces here as an API Evangelist network profile; FirstClub is a consumer mobile-app business and currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Swiggy
providers.description: Swiggy is an Indian hyperlocal on-demand commerce and food-delivery platform founded in 2014 and headquartered in Bengaluru. Through a single consumer app it connects users with restaurant and merchant partners for food delivery, Swiggy Instamart (quick grocery and essentials commerce), Swiggy Genie (pick-up and drop errands), Swiggy Dineout (restaurant reservations and dining), and the Swiggy One membership program, operating across hundreds of cities in India with a large network of restaurant and delivery partners. Swiggy is a publicly listed company backed by Accel, Bessemer Venture Partners, Norwest Venture Partners and SoftBank Vision Fund. It exposes a login-gated merchant partner portal but does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Vetic
providers.description: Vetic is a pet healthcare company in India operating a chain of full-service veterinary clinics and hospitals across 11 cities, paired with a consumer mobile app. Founded by Gaurav Ajmera (ex-COO OYO), Vetic offers in-clinic vet consultations, vaccinations, in-house diagnostics (blood work, X-ray, imaging, endoscopy), surgery, physiotherapy, 24/7 emergency and intensive care, grooming, an in-house pharmacy, pet supplies, pet insurance, video vet consultations, digital medical records, and 2-hour pet food delivery. It is a consumer (B2C) business with no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and app footprint.

providers.name: Chai Shots
providers.description: Chai Shots is a Hyderabad-based microdrama OTT streaming platform for vertical, short-form fiction where every episode runs under two minutes. Built by the Chai Bisket team (co-founders Sharath Chandra and Anurag Reddy), it is positioned as India's first regional short-series OTT, launching in Telugu and other regional Indian languages for Gen Z and tier II/III audiences. The platform offers pay-per-episode and unlimited subscription access, a creator-first "Clap" tipping feature, and an AI-native production workflow. It raised a $5M seed round co-led by InfoEdge Ventures and General Catalyst. Chai Shots is a consumer content app with no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile carries the company's identity and published web properties.

providers.name: Oto Capital
providers.description: OTO (Oto Capital) is India's leading platform to discover, research, and buy two-wheelers online with embedded financing. It offers digital bike loans with eligibility checks in five minutes and loan approvals within thirty minutes, an EMI calculator, home delivery, and test rides across 22+ Indian cities, working with 10+ lending partners including Northern Arc, Western Capital, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, and Suryoday Small Finance Bank. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface is currently published by the company.

providers.name: Rigi
providers.description: Rigi (Rigi TV) is an instant-entertainment mobile app that streams quick, captivating, and scroll-worthy short-form video and micro-drama series across genres such as romance, drama, thriller, and suspense. Operated out of HSR Layout in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India and backed by Accel, it delivers on-demand vertical entertainment through its Android app. It is a consumer-facing streaming product; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal surface is currently published.

providers.name: Wheelocity
providers.description: Wheelocity (Wheelocity Fresh Private Limited) is a Bangalore, India based logistics and supply-chain company building daily fresh-produce and grocery delivery networks for underserved rural markets across India, which it frames as "the access rails for Bharat commerce." Its phygital (online plus offline) model combines location intelligence, IoT hardware, cold-chain and predictive demand forecasting with an electric-vehicle first-mile and last-mile fleet and a consumer app branded WoW. The company reports serving more than one million households, running over 100,000 km of EV movement daily and avoiding tens of thousands of kilograms of produce waste each day. Wheelocity is a venture-backed operating company (Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio) and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: ANSR
providers.description: ANSR Global is a workforce and operations company that helps enterprises build, manage, and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) — captive technology and shared-services hubs, most often in India and other emerging markets. Its end-to-end offering spans four areas: Talent Solutions (AI-driven recruiting, sourcing, onboarding, and talent management), Workspace (managed, customized office space and workplace strategy), Business Operations (payroll, HR, employer-of-record, compliance, legal, and finance/tax), and Research & Advisory (organizational design, capability planning, and market intelligence). ANSR engages clients through Global Capability Center subscriptions, Build-Operate-Transfer arrangements, and Managed Teams, and operates a proprietary workforce platform, 1Wrk. The company reports 20+ years of operations, 210+ global centers established, 225,000+ professionals hired, and 14M+ square feet of managed workspace. ANSR is a portfolio company of Accel. It is a business-services provider and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: One Assist
providers.description: OneAssist is an Indian consumer protection and services company that provides device and appliance protection, extended warranty, and financial-fraud assistance to retail customers. Its offerings span gadget protection for mobile phones, laptops, wearables, and tablets (accidental damage and extended warranty coverage), home appliance repair and maintenance for air conditioners, televisions, washing machines, refrigerators, water purifiers, and geysers, wallet and card fraud protection, credit-card bill-payment assistance, and furniture, motor, and jewelry insurance plans. The company reports serving over 1.8 crore active customers across 19,000+ pincodes and resolving more than 25 lakh issues. OneAssist is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this profile, OneAssist publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it operates a consumer-facing web and mobile experience only.

providers.name: Vegrow
providers.description: Vegrow is a Bengaluru-based B2B fruits marketplace founded in 2020 by IIT alumni that connects Indian fruit farmers with demand outlets across retail channels, using technology to match produce such as apples, bananas, pomegranates, and grapes with buyers, handling grading, sorting, quality assurance, and delivery, and paying farmers digitally. Backed by GIC, Prosus Ventures, Matrix Partners India, Elevation Capital, Lightspeed, and Ankur Capital, it raised a $46M round led by GIC in December 2023. Vegrow publishes no public API or developer program today.

providers.name: Officebanao
providers.description: Officebanao is a technology-enabled office interior design and build company headquartered in Gurugram and Bengaluru, India, and founded in 2021. It delivers turnkey commercial workspace solutions — space planning, interior design, furniture procurement, office renovation, and end-to-end project execution — for startups, enterprises, and coworking spaces across 40+ Indian cities. Its "Tech plus Touch" delivery model pairs real-time 3D visualization and online progress tracking with an in-house team of designers and project managers. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Officebanao publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer platform surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: Jeh Aerospace
providers.description: Jeh Aerospace is a precision aerospace manufacturing company building "future factories" across the US-India corridor to supply aerostructures and aero-engine components for the commercial aerospace supply chain. From certified facilities in India spanning more than 160,000 square feet, Jeh delivers machining, sheet metal, tubes and pipes, surface treatment, structural assembly, and engineering services on time and at scale. The company is fully compliant with AS9100, ISO 9001, OEM requirements, and export regulations, and weaves a digital thread across its supplier networks for radical transparency. Jeh operates from both the US and India and is backed by General Catalyst and IndiGo Ventures.

providers.name: Mirana Toys
providers.description: Mirana Toys (Mirana Innovations Pvt Ltd) is an India-based smart-toy company and OEM/ODM manufacturer of electronic toys — RC cars, monster trucks, drones, educational toys, and AI/AR toys. It pairs its consumer products with the Mirana smart app (iOS and Android), a mobile gaming platform that lets kids and adults control and play with Mirana toys over Bluetooth. As an OEM partner it offers in-house PCB/PCBA design and SMT assembly, tooling and mold design, mobile app development, compliance support (ASTM, EN-71, RoHS, ISO, SMETA), and global logistics for toy brands and retailers. Backed by Accel. The company publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and support center but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Bizongo
providers.description: Bizongo is a Mumbai-based B2B commerce and supply-chain platform founded in 2015 that digitizes procurement, vendor management, and supply-chain financing for enterprises across India, with a focus on packaging, raw materials, and made-to-order goods. It operates a SaaS-led vendor digitization stack plus an embedded-finance offering, connecting large buyers with a network of manufacturing partners. Bizongo is backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, B Capital, and others. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass Bizongo publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known discovery surface — third-party logistics integration is offered only through carrier aggregators such as ClickPost, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

providers.name: Cholamandalam
providers.description: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company (Chola) is an Indian non-banking financial company (NBFC) headquartered in Chennai and part of the Murugappa Group (CIN L65993TN1978PLC007576). It provides lending across vehicle finance (commercial vehicles, cars, two-wheelers, three-wheelers, tractors and construction equipment), home loans and loan against property, SME/MSME and business loans, supply chain finance, gold loans, and consumer and personal loans through a branch network across India. No public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment; the company operates consumer/branch and mobile-app (Chola One) channels rather than a published developer program. Group affiliates include Chola Securities and the Gaadi Bazaar vehicle marketplace.

providers.name: Fivestargroup
providers.description: Five Star Group (Five Star Business Finance) is an India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) that provides small-business and mortgage loans to self-employed and underserved borrowers, primarily across southern India. Its public web presence is an investor-relations and customer-service portal covering board and management disclosures, financials, annual reports, NCD and SEBI (LODR) compliances, RBI policies, credit ratings, and investor grievance redressal, alongside customer tools such as a loan mobile app, online EMI payments, and NACH mandate cancellation. It is listed in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer program, API, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: MemeChat
providers.description: MemeChat is an Indian consumer social and creator-economy mobile app from MemeChat Private Limited (Memetech), where users make, share, and compete with memes — including a Face Swap AI feature and a MemeChat keyboard — and earn money when their content goes viral. Marketed as a self-reliant ("Atmanirbhar") Indian app that has crossed five million users, it is backed by 500 Global. This API Evangelist profile is a network stub: MemeChat is a consumer application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface discovered at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Ofbusiness
providers.description: OfBusiness is one of India's largest B2B raw-materials procurement and credit platforms, serving more than two million SMEs and corporates. It operates as an aggregator, manufacturer, and importer/exporter across supply chains including steel, aluminium, chemicals, polymers, and agriculture, pairing live commodity pricing, quotations, and order tracking with working-capital credit through its NBFC arm Oxyzo. Related brands include BidAssist (government tender and procurement intelligence), SMEAssist, and Ved AI. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. OfBusiness reaches customers primarily through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps; no public developer API or API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: PropTiger
providers.description: PropTiger.com is one of India's leading online real estate advisory and transaction platforms, founded in 2011 and now part of the REA India group (alongside Housing.com). It helps home buyers discover, evaluate, and purchase residential property across major Indian cities, combining property search and locality research with on-ground advisory, legal paperwork guidance, and home-loan assistance. The public surface is a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace; as of this enrichment pass PropTiger publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server. This profile captures verifiable company identity, published consumer pages, and live domain-security posture. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Veritasfin
providers.description: Veritas Finance Limited is a non-banking finance company (NBFC) in India focused on retail and micro, small and medium enterprise (MSME) lending to underserved and self-employed customers. Its lending products include MSME and business loans, loan against property, home loans, mortgage and working-capital finance, and used commercial vehicle loans, supported by an EMI calculator, branch network, online payment portals and an investor-relations and corporate-governance section. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Public probing of veritasfin.in finds a corporate financial-services website with no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface at this time.

providers.name: Niyo Solutions
providers.description: Niyo Solutions (brand: Niyo, goniyo.com) is a Bengaluru, India based consumer fintech founded in 2015 by Vinay Bagri and Virender Bisht, focused on international travel banking and savings for Indian retail customers. Niyo is not a chartered bank; it operates as a neo-banking front end layered on partner RBI-licensed banks — DCB Bank (current flagship for the Niyo zero-forex savings + debit card), SBM Bank India (previous "Niyo Global" forex card, now wound down for new customers and operating a secured credit card variant), Equitas Small Finance Bank (salary / "Niyo Bharat" account) and IDFC FIRST Bank (earlier Niyo Global issuer) — plus card network rails (Visa, RuPay). Niyo's flagship surface is the "zero forex markup" Niyo Global / DCB Niyo Global / SBM Niyo Global Visa debit and prepaid travel cards accepted in 180+ countries, paired with a digital savings account delivered through partner banks. The company has expanded beyond cards into a full travel-banking stack including currency exchange and forex cash delivery, outbound remittance (Send Money Abroad), international flights, hotels and curated experiences, Niyo Express airport services, an international travel eSIM, travel visa assistance, travel insurance, a premium subscription tier, a student program (Niyo Scholarship, NISAP) and a DCB Niyo Secured Credit Card backed by a fixed deposit. Niyo serves over one million international travellers and has raised capital from investors including Accel, Lightrock, Beams Fintech Fund, Tencent, Horizons Ventures, Prime Venture Partners and JS Capital. There is no public REST developer API, partner banking-as-a-service surface, SDK, MCP server, or GitHub organisation — Niyo is delivered exclusively as a B2C iOS and Android mobile application with a marketing and tools website at goniyo.com.

providers.name: MediSage
providers.description: MediSage is an India-based digital health company that operates one of Asia's largest online medical communities, connecting doctors and healthcare practitioners with first-hand, peer-reviewed medical information, live CME webinars, clinical discussion forums, medical news, and professional networking. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, MediSage delivers its knowledge platform primarily through consumer-facing web and mobile applications for physicians; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or partner integration surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Sadbhav Engineering Limited
providers.description: Sadbhav Engineering Limited (SEL), operating at sadbhaveng.com, is an Indian infrastructure and civil-engineering contractor founded in 1988 by Vishnubhai M. Patel and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The company builds and operates large-scale roads and highways, mining, and irrigation projects, including Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) concessions of national significance, and is publicly listed on the NSE and BSE. This is a traditional infrastructure/construction firm: it publishes an investor-relations and corporate website but exposes no developer API, SDK, documentation, or other machine-readable API surface. Surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a stub via vc-portfolio harvesting; an enrichment pass confirmed there is no API product to catalog.

providers.name: Material Depot
providers.description: Material Depot is India's design-first interior-materials marketplace and experience-centre network, headquartered in Bengaluru and founded in 2022. It helps homeowners, architects, interior designers, builders and contractors discover, compare, visualize and purchase interior-design materials — tiles, laminates, wall panels, plywood, wallpapers, flooring, sanitaryware and countertops — spanning 300,000+ products across 1,000+ brands and 100+ categories. The company blends online discovery with physical experience centres in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, offering sample ordering, store-visit booking, free design consultations, video-call shopping, mix-and-match visualization, bulk/trade quotations and pan-India delivery. Backed by Accel, Material Depot operates a consumer/B2B web marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Oyo Rooms
providers.description: OYO Rooms (Oravel Stays / OYO Hotels & Homes) is a hospitality technology company headquartered in Gurugram, India that operates a global chain of franchised and leased budget hotels, homes, and living spaces. Founded by Ritesh Agarwal in 2013, OYO standardizes and distributes independent hotel inventory through its consumer booking apps and website, and provides property owners with a partner management platform for listings, pricing, and operations. OYO is a consumer travel and accommodation brand; as of this enrichment pass it does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: ApnaMart
providers.description: ApnaMart (Apna Mart) is a Bengaluru-based Indian retail and quick-commerce company founded in 2022 by Chetan Kumar Garg and Abhishek Singh. It operates a network of franchise-model neighborhood grocery and FMCG stores combined with a 15-minute delivery app, serving customers across roughly 14 cities including tier-2 and tier-3 markets such as Ranchi, Hazaribagh, and Bilaspur. Backed by Accel, Peak XV, and Fundamentum, the company blends brick-and-mortar retail with on-demand delivery of daily essentials. ApnaMart is a consumer retail business and does not publish a public developer platform or API surface; this profile in the API Evangelist network captures its identity, domain-security posture, and published web properties.

providers.name: ElasticRun
providers.description: ElasticRun (legally NTEx Transportation Services Pvt Ltd) is a Pune, India based B2B e-commerce and rural logistics platform founded in 2016 by Sandeep Deshmukh, Saurabh Nigam and Shitiz Bansal. It operates an aggregated, variable-capacity transportation network that stitches together idle logistics capacity to connect FMCG brands and manufacturers to the mom-and-pop kirana stores of rural and semi-urban India. The platform blends mobile technology with local entrepreneurs to run an assisted-commerce model spanning 125,000+ kiranas and 80,000+ villages across 26 states, offering last-mile delivery, B2B distribution and supply-chain services. ElasticRun is backed by Prosus Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile is a network stub: no public developer API, documentation or SDKs were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Rcom
providers.description: Rcom (Reliance Communications, RCOM) is an Indian telecommunications and digital infrastructure company providing enterprise connectivity, voice, and data-center services. Its portfolio spans dedicated internet access and DDoS protection, IP transit, MPLS VPN, Ethernet and leased lines, cloud networking (Cloud X Fusion / Cloud X WAN), enterprise voice (E1 PRI, SIP trunk, IP Centrex), cloud telephony and hosted contact centers, toll-free and global access numbers, audio/web conferencing, colocation and managed data-center services, and global subsea cable networks via its Global Cloud Xchange subsidiary. The company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment confirms an enterprise service business with customer and billing portals but no public developer program, API surface, or well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: Uni Cards
providers.description: Uni Cards (Uniorbit Technologies) is a Bangalore-based Indian consumer fintech backed by Accel that builds credit-card and pay-later products, best known for its Uni Pay 1/3rd Card and co-branded credit cards delivered through its consumer mobile app. Uni Cards publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; its api.uni.cards and docs.uni.cards hosts resolve but are closed behind a Cloudflare challenge, so its API surface is internal-only today.

providers.name: CityMall
providers.description: CityMall is an Indian social-commerce and e-commerce platform operated by Rashanbox Retail Private Limited (CIN U52190HR2020PTC086114), serving Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns through a community-group-buying model. Customers shop across groceries, staples, fashion, electronics, home and kitchen, beauty and health, kids and toys, and books and stationery, with cash-on-delivery and free-delivery options via web and native Android/iOS apps. The company runs on modern web infrastructure (CloudFront CDN, next-gen image optimization) and is backed by Accel, General Catalyst, and Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and its verified domain-security posture.

providers.name: CRED
providers.description: CRED is an Indian consumer fintech that started with premium credit-card bill payments and rewards and has expanded into peer-to-peer payments (Scan & Pay, Tap to Pay, RuPay credit card on UPI), short-term credit (CRED Cash, CRED Mint), wealth (CRED Money), e-commerce (CRED Store), and travel. CRED's surface area is overwhelmingly consumer-app and the company does not publish a public, self-service developer portal. Its engineering organisation contributes to the broader ecosystem via the engineering.cred.club tech blog and open-source repositories under the CRED-CLUB GitHub org. B2B integrations (merchant acceptance, issuer partnerships, etc.) are negotiated directly with the partnerships team.

providers.name: Trinkerr
providers.description: Trinkerr is a Bengaluru, India algorithmic and social trading platform founded in 2021 by Manvendra Singh and Gaurav Agarwal, backed by Accel and India Quotient. Its mobile app (com.trinkerr.app) automates trades with ready-made algos crafted by industry experts for stock market enthusiasts. As of 2026-07-21 the company website trinkerr.com resolves to a GoDaddy parked page, no api/docs/developer subdomains resolve, and no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface could be found, though the Google Play listing, LinkedIn, and YouTube channel remain live. Trinkerr does not currently publish a public API.

providers.name: Zet
providers.description: Zet is a Bengaluru, India fintech that helps unserved and underserved Indians enter the formal credit system. Its core product is a fixed-deposit-backed (FD-backed) secured credit card starting at very low deposits, requiring no income proof or prior credit history, alongside credit-score monitoring and improvement tools, UPI payments, cashback rewards, a ZET Plus subscription tier, and a ZET Fixit credit-report error-resolution service. Backed by General Catalyst and Sequoia Capital, Zet operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) and, as of this enrichment pass, exposes no public developer platform, API, OpenAPI, or documented developer surface.

providers.name: Travelguru
providers.description: Travelguru was an Indian online hotel-booking brand that grew into one of India's larger hotel-distribution platforms before Yatra.com acquired a 100% stake in July 2012. The brand has since been folded into Yatra: travelguru.com and the Travel Partner Web hotel extranet now redirect to yatra.com, the former Desiya B2B distribution host is offline, and Travelguru publishes no standalone developer portal or public API surface today. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Battery Ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Ninjacart
providers.description: Ninjacart is India's largest agritech B2B fresh-produce supply-chain company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bengaluru. It connects farmers and producers directly with retailers, kirana stores, and businesses, removing layers of middlemen from the fruit-and-vegetable supply chain. Its product portfolio spans Ninja Mandi (wholesale produce marketplace), Ninja Kisan (farmer sourcing), Ninja Kirana (retailer supply), and Ninja Global, alongside a technology-licensing model, Ninja Tech Ventures, and a Startup Program that gives FoodTech/AgTech startups access to its supply-chain tooling (demand forecasting, pricing intelligence, procurement, inventory, logistics, and catalog management). Ninjacart is backed by investors including Accel, Tiger Global, and Walmart/Flipkart. As of this profile it exposes no public self-serve developer API or documentation; technology access is handled through partnerships (partnerships@ninjacart.com).

providers.name: Nueclear
providers.description: Nueclear Healthcare Limited, founded in 2011 and powered by Thyrocare, is one of India's leading cancer-diagnostics chains, operating a nationwide network of PET-CT and CT scan centres. It offers advanced whole-body, PSMA, DOPA, brain and bone PET-CT scans plus plain and contrast CT imaging for cancer diagnosis at affordable rates, with centres across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Lucknow, Nashik and Surat. Nueclear is a consumer diagnostic-imaging provider and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Infra.Market
providers.description: Infra.Market is a technology-enabled building materials platform serving India's construction and real estate sectors across the entire project lifecycle. Operating as a house of brands, it supplies concrete, aggregates, steel, AAC blocks, plywood, tiles, sanitaryware, paints, plumbing, modular kitchens, hardware, electricals, appliances, and rental equipment through both B2B (direct corporate sales with site delivery) and B2R (retail via dealers and distributors across 17,000+ touchpoints). It is backed by 280+ manufacturing facilities across 22 Indian states under brands including Shalimar Paints, RDC, IVAS, Robo, and Ultrafine, and is headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company; no public developer API surface has been identified to date.

providers.name: BlackBuck
providers.description: BlackBuck, operated by Zinka Logistics Solutions and incorporated in 2015, runs India's largest digital trucking platform, digitizing the truck-operator lifecycle for roughly a million truck operators (about 28% of India's truckers) across 100,000+ villages. Its super-app spans a loads marketplace, FASTag toll payments, fuel, GPS/telematics, vehicle and working-capital financing, and a used-trucks marketplace. Listed on the NSE as BLACKBUCK since November 2024, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API documentation, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment; this profile carries the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: FairMoney
providers.description: FairMoney is a credit-led digital bank for emerging markets, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Paris, France, with operating subsidiaries in Nigeria and India. The company began life as a France-incubated micro- lending app and pivoted to focus on Africa, becoming one of the largest digital lenders in Nigeria after the Central Bank of Nigeria granted its subsidiary a Microfinance Bank (MfB) license. FairMoney's consumer mobile app offers near-instant collateral-free personal loans, FlexiCredit, asset finance, savings products (FairLock, FairSave, FairTarget, FairDollar), a current account, debit cards, bill payments, and peer-to-peer transfers. Its Business Banking arm extends current accounts, payments, and credit to Nigerian SMEs. In India, FairMoney operates as a digital lender disbursing small-ticket personal loans through its mobile app. FairMoney does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a third-party developer portal; integration is internal and partner- driven, and the company's only public technical surface is its engineering GitHub organization, which mirrors infrastructure-as-code and open-source tooling forks (Terraform AWS modules, GitHub Actions, rubocop, puma plugins, salesforce_bulk_api) rather than a product API.

providers.name: Matrimony Com
providers.description: Matrimony.com Ltd is India's largest wed-tech company and a pioneer in online matchmaking since 2000. Headquartered in Chennai, it operates BharatMatrimony, EliteMatrimony, CommunityMatrimony, Jodii, MeraLuv and 300+ community and regional matrimony portals, alongside wedding-services brands WeddingBazaar, Mandap.com, ManyJobs and WeddingGiftBox. Publicly listed on the NSE and BSE, the company serves roughly 7.5 million customers monthly and is backed by investors including Mayfield. It is a consumer-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time.

providers.name: NephroPlus
providers.description: NephroPlus is India's largest dialysis network, operating 500+ dialysis centers across the country and delivering kidney care through in-clinic hemodialysis, home hemodialysis, and peritoneal dialysis, alongside allied nephrology services and a training academy for dialysis technicians. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, the company reaches patients through its consumer website and mobile apps (iOS and Android). It was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass NephroPlus publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: Open
providers.description: Open (Open Financial Technologies) operates at open.money as an India-based fintech offering a connected digital business banking platform for SMEs and startups. It pairs a business current account with invoicing, payments, automated accounting, expense management and payroll, letting founders run their banking and finance operations from a single dashboard. Open is a Speedinvest portfolio company. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; the company website is protected by Cloudflare and no public OpenAPI could be harvested during enrichment.

providers.name: Moneyview
providers.description: Moneyview is an India-based digital financial services platform and consumer fintech app offering instant personal loans (up to 10 lakh), home loans, loan against property, credit cards, credit score checks, insurance, digital gold investment, UPI payments, EMI calculators, and personal-finance tools. It operates an RBI-guideline-compliant, paperless lending experience via web and mobile apps for Indian consumers. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API surface, SDKs, developer portal, or OpenAPI: no developer/docs/api subdomain resolves and /.well-known/ discovery paths are blocked. It does publish a site-level llms.txt describing its consumer products. Backed by Ribbit Capital; surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Bzaar
providers.description: Bzaar is a cross-border business-to-business wholesale marketplace founded in 2020-2021 by Nishant Verman (previously head of corporate development at Flipkart) and Prasanth Nair (previously engineering and product at Amazon, Flipkart, and Lazada), headquartered in Palo Alto / San Francisco, California with operations in India. The platform connected small and medium retailers in the United States and other markets with curated suppliers and manufacturers in India and Southeast Asia, listing thousands of products across home, lifestyle, accessories, apparel, jewelry, cookware, and bakeware verticals, and layering sourcing services such as vendor management, quality control, consolidated logistics, and cross-border payments on top of the catalog. Bzaar raised a $4 million seed round led by Canaan Partners with participation from Binny Bansal, Sameer Nigam, Rahul Chari, Lee Fixel, and Ashish Gupta. As of this enrichment pass Bzaar publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface, and its bzaar.com domain resolves to a registrar parking page rather than a live product site.

providers.name: Koo
providers.description: Koo was an Indian microblogging and social networking platform built by Bombinate Technologies, positioned as a multilingual, India-first alternative to Twitter/X with support for Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and other regional languages. Backed by Accel and Tiger Global, it grew during the 2021 Indian social-media policy disputes before ceasing operations in 2024 after funding and acquisition talks fell through. Koo never published a public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs, and its domain no longer serves a site — this profile is retained as a verified-defunct historical record rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: SnapDeal
providers.description: Snapdeal is an Indian e-commerce marketplace founded in February 2010 by Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal and headquartered in Gurugram/New Delhi. It began as a daily-deals platform and grew into a value-focused online marketplace that connects third-party sellers with buyers across categories such as fashion, home and kitchen, electronics accessories, and general merchandise, primarily serving price-sensitive shoppers in India's smaller cities and towns. Sellers onboard and manage catalog, orders, and payouts through the Snapdeal seller portal (seller.snapdeal.com). Snapdeal has been backed by investors including SoftBank, Bessemer Venture Partners, Nexus Venture Partners, and Kalaari Capital. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners; enrichment found no public developer portal, no api.snapdeal.com or developer.snapdeal.com host, and no published API specification or well-known discovery surface — the seller portal is login-gated behind SSO.

providers.name: Captain Fresh
providers.description: Captain Fresh is a Bangalore, India based B2B technology company building sustainable seafood and animal-protein supply chains worldwide, connecting fishermen, farmers, processors and retailers through a technology-enabled sourcing, cold-chain and distribution marketplace. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates across India and international markets. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer / supply-chain company profile; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment (a marketing website only).

providers.name: Matrimony.com
providers.description: Matrimony.com Limited is an India-based online matchmaking and wedding services company, publicly listed on the NSE and BSE and headquartered in Chennai. Founded by Murugavel Janakiraman, it operates the flagship BharatMatrimony brand alongside a large portfolio of regional and community matrimony sites (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, and religion- and community-based platforms), the premium EliteMatrimony service, and wedding-services properties including WeddingBazaar and Mandap.com. The company serves millions of customers each month across its matchmaking and marriage marketplace. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Matrimony.com publishes a corporate/investor and consumer-brand web presence but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Koinex
providers.description: Koinex was an Indian digital-asset exchange launched in 2017, describing itself as India's first and largest cryptocurrency exchange with more than one million users. It offered spot trading across multiple crypto assets with INR pairs before regulatory uncertainty around Indian banking access forced it to shut down all services in June 2019, asking users to withdraw their holdings by July 15, 2019. The company is DEFUNCT: koinex.in now serves only a single static wind-down notice directing former users to claim any crypto assets left on the platform through CoinDCX, with which Koinex partnered for the transition. There is no live product, developer portal, documentation, or API surface; the domain's TLS certificate expired in March 2025 and every path other than the notice returns 403. Retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical record of a shut-down crypto exchange and as a Pantera Capital portfolio lead.

providers.name: Nse-india
providers.description: National Stock Exchange of India (NSE), operating at nseindia.com, is one of the world's largest stock exchanges by number of trades and derivatives contracts, headquartered in Mumbai. It runs electronic equity, derivatives, debt, and currency markets, publishes market data and corporate filings, and maintains the Nifty family of indices via NSE Indices. NSE exposes market data primarily through licensed data feeds and the undocumented endpoints powering nseindia.com rather than a published public developer API program; this profile was surfaced as an enrichment lead and has no documented public REST API surface at this time.

providers.name: bigbasket
providers.description: bigbasket is India's largest online grocery and daily-essentials retailer, now part of the Tata Group, delivering fresh produce, packaged foods, household, and personal-care products across Indian cities via web and mobile apps (bigbasket, bbnow, and bbdaily subscription delivery). Surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. bigbasket operates as a consumer app rather than an API platform: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs. Its only first-party public developer surface is the github.com/BigBasket organization and the open-source @bb-tech react-admin UI component libraries on npm.

providers.name: Hungama
providers.description: Hungama (Hungama Digital Media Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.) is an Indian digital entertainment company operating a video-on-demand and audio OTT platform. Hungama.com offers trending web series, popular movies, Hungama Originals, music, podcasts, audiobooks, and audio stories across Hindi, Bollywood, Punjabi, and regional Indian content. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Hungama publishes a public LLM Access Policy (llms.txt) governing how AI systems may crawl, summarize, and reference its content, but exposes no public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: InstaPaisa
providers.description: InstaPaisa was an India-based personal-finance and lending fintech surfaced as a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company appears defunct or absorbed — its domain instapaisa.com resolves (Amazon CloudFront) but redirects to InCred Finance (incred.com), an Indian digital lending / NBFC platform, indicating an acquisition or wind-down. No public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification was found for InstaPaisa, so no API artifacts could be harvested or derived; only live domain-security signals for instapaisa.com were probed.

providers.name: Itzcash
providers.description: Itzcash (ItzCash Card Ltd, operated by Ebix Payment Services Private Limited, CIN U74999MH2006PTC160835, Mumbai) was one of India's early prepaid payment and digital-payments companies, offering prepaid/gift cards, utility and bill payments, domestic money transfer, insurance and travel payments, and an agent-assisted retail payment network across India. The company was acquired by Ebix, Inc. in 2017 and folded into the EbixCash financial-exchange business. The ItzCash brand has since been retired: www.itzcash.com now redirects to ebixcash.com, and there is no first-party ItzCash developer portal, public API, or OpenAPI definition. This profile was surfaced as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company and is retained as a historical company record in the API Evangelist network. Any live API surface belongs to the parent EbixCash entity (an "Ebixcash API Hub" root responds at api.ebixcash.com), not to the ItzCash brand.

providers.name: Mintifi
providers.description: Mintifi is an Indian supply-chain financing platform that provides inventory and working-capital financing to SMEs, distributors, and dealers across manufacturer distribution networks. Its products include checkout and inventory financing, an Electronic Invoice Presentment and Payment (EIPP) solution for ERP-integrated invoice settlement and reconciliation, WhatsApp-based inventory financing, and Mintifi Collect for payment collection with Tally integration. The company exposes ERP-integration APIs to partners and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation is currently published; the docs host is access-gated.

providers.name: NAKAD
providers.description: NAKAD is India's leading Reconciliation-as-a-Service platform, a fintech delivering cash-flow and working-capital solutions to small businesses and MSMEs. Its proprietary MicroBill technology enables lending and loans through invoice discounting, invoice factoring and reverse factoring so suppliers receive early payment, with built-in reconciliation for accounts receivable, accounts payable, payments, debit notes, credit notes and banking. Backed by Accel. No public developer API surface, documentation, SDKs, or well-known discovery documents were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Okcredit
providers.description: OkCredit is a mobile digital ledger (bahi khata) application for small business owners and merchants across India, letting shopkeepers record credit and payment transactions digitally, send automated collection reminders over SMS and WhatsApp, and share account statements with customers. The consumer-facing Android and iOS apps replace the traditional paper udhaar ledger; the company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Tripoto Travel
providers.description: Tripoto is a travel community and trip-planning platform where travelers discover destinations, read and publish first-person travel itineraries and stories, and browse and book curated trips, tours, and experiences. Content is largely user-generated, with travel guides organized by destination, theme, and season. Tripoto was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. At the time of this profile no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was discoverable; an api.tripoto.com host exists but serves the consumer application backend.

providers.name: Medi Assist
providers.description: MediBuddy (Medi Assist) is a Bessemer Venture Partners-backed digital healthcare platform based in India that lets consumers and corporate health-benefit members book online doctor consultations, order lab tests and diagnostic health checkups, buy medicines, and access cashless hospitalization and insurance-linked care through a single app and website. It operates as a consumer-facing health services marketplace; at the time of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification. This profile records what could be verified from the public web surface.

providers.name: Ola Electric
providers.description: Ola Electric is an Indian electric-vehicle manufacturer building electric scooters (the S1 family), electric motorcycles (the Roadster line), and home energy solutions (Ola Shakti battery systems), all designed and produced in India around its in-house 4680 Bharat Cell and ferrite-motor technology. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, the company operates a nationwide Hypercharger fast-charging network and Hyperservice center footprint across India. As a consumer EV and energy hardware manufacturer, Ola Electric publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Wiom
providers.description: Wiom is an Indian consumer internet company offering recharge-based home broadband: shared WiFi delivered over a community mesh network so households can pay only for the internet they actually use, without a mobile-data plan or a traditional fixed-line broadband contract. It was surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Accel. As of this enrichment pass Wiom operates a consumer marketing website (a React single-page application) but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface, so this profile carries verified identity and a live domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Anar
providers.description: Anar was a B2B marketplace and business networking mobile app for small businesses, sellers, and buyers in India, operating from 2020 to 2023 before shutting down. At its peak it reported 1.6M+ registered businesses, 450k+ sellers, 1.1M+ buyers, and 7M+ business enquiries processed across 6.6M+ listed products. It raised roughly $6.5M from Accel and Elevation Capital plus angel investors. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company; no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation was ever published, and the service is now defunct.

providers.name: Breathe Well-being
providers.description: Breathe Well-being is an India-based digital therapeutics and chronic-care company focused on Type 2 diabetes reversal and management. Through a mobile app (Android/iOS) it pairs continuous health coaching, personalized nutrition and lifestyle plans, medical supervision, and progress tracking to help members reduce blood sugar, lose weight, and lower medication dependence. Founded by Aditya Kaicker and Rohan Verma, the company is backed by Accel and Y Combinator (Series A, 2021). It operates as a direct-to-consumer health program rather than an API provider: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface (paths return the SPA lander fallback). This profile captures the company identity and its probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Frontrow
providers.description: FrontRow was an India-based edtech company that operated an online learning platform teaching extracurricular skills and hobbies — such as music, singing, guitar, drawing, chess and other creative pursuits — to learners through recorded video courses and community-driven classes. The company was backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of the last enrichment pass the product has shut down: its primary domain frontrow.co.in 301-redirects to a Medium shutdown announcement confirming "FrontRow shut down a few months ago," and no developer portal, public API, documentation, or SDK surface exists. This entry is retained as a defunct portfolio-lead record; there are no live API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Nabhdrishti Aerospace
providers.description: Nabhdrishti Aerospace is a Bangalore-based deep-tech startup building India's first fuel-flex micro gas turbine for aviation and power generation. Its ND 400 engine is a 400 N single-core micro gas turbine designed for UAVs, hybrid-electric aircraft, and small aircraft as well as oil & gas, manufacturing, and vehicle range-extender power generation, running on conventional fuels, biofuels, and hydrogen with an innovative recuperator design that targets greater than 15% efficiency at under half the cost of competing turbines. Backed by Accel, the company raised USD 3M and operates from the IISc Bangalore IHUB. As a hardware manufacturer it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks its public web presence.

providers.name: OnlineTyari
providers.description: OnlineTyari is one of India's largest online exam-preparation platforms, built by Next Door Learning Solutions Private Limited (Jaipur, Rajasthan) and acquired by Embibe in February 2020. Through its website and Android/iOS apps it helps students and job aspirants prepare for competitive government examinations such as SSC CGL, IBPS PO/Clerk, RRB, Railways NTPC, and various State PSC exams, offering mock tests, question banks, current-affairs updates, e-books, and study material in Hindi and English produced with independent tutors, coaching institutes, and subject authors. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass, OnlineTyari operates as a consumer-facing exam-prep product and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Paytm Payments Bank
providers.description: Paytm Payments Bank Limited is an Indian payments bank headquartered in Noida, offering digital savings and current accounts, the Paytm Wallet, FASTag, debit cards, UPI and other retail banking services to consumers and merchants. It operates as a distinct entity from Paytm's merchant payment-gateway developer platform (One97 Communications), and does not publish its own public developer API surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Quick Ride
providers.description: Quick Ride is an Indian mobility platform offering carpooling, bikepool, and taxi services across major cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Kochi, NCR, and Chandigarh. Riders book airport, outstation, rental, and local trips across vehicle classes from hatchbacks to luxury SUVs, or share commutes via car and bike pooling to cut cost and congestion. The service is delivered through consumer iOS and Android apps. No public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, MCP, SDKs) is published; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures and enriched via live web and DNS/TLS probes.

providers.name: Regency Healthcare
providers.description: Regency Healthcare is a multi-specialty tertiary and super-speciality hospital network in northern India, operating five centres across Kanpur, Lucknow and Gorakhpur with 240+ doctors and physicians covering 20+ medical specialties including cardiology, oncology (cancer care), nephrology, orthopedics and gastroenterology. Patient-facing services include appointment booking, emergency and ambulance care, diagnostic imaging (PET-CT), and an online lab-report portal. Surfaced as a portfolio lead of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pipeline found no public developer/API surface for this provider.

providers.name: Sayre Therapeutics
providers.description: Sayre Therapeutics is a healthcare company founded in 2015 that brings innovative treatments for rare, orphan, and life-threatening diseases to India and the broader SAARC region. It works across clinical research, regulatory strategy, and commercialization and market access, partnering with global licensors to bring US-, EU-, and Japan-approved drugs, drug-delivery devices, and diagnostics to South Asian markets under local regulatory standards. Its portfolio spans special-access and commercially approved products, diagnostics, biosimilars, and niche generics. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Zepto
providers.description: Zepto (Zepto Marketplace Private Limited) is an Indian quick-commerce grocery delivery company founded in 2021 that delivers groceries, fresh fruits and vegetables, meat, pet care, beauty and household products "in minutes" from a network of dark stores across major Indian cities. It operates a consumer-facing mobile app and website (zepto.com, formerly zeptonow.com) and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its partner-facing surfaces are limited to merchant onboarding (Sell on Zepto / brands.zepto.co.in), delivery-partner and franchise programs. Backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Aggra
providers.description: Aggra Technologies Private Limited operates Moneytor, an autonomous, self-learning platform for stressed loan recovery. Founded in 2017 in Mumbai, India by Ayush Srivastava and Anubhav Singh, Moneytor delivers debt management, collections, enterprise collections software, and distressed-debt / portfolio purchase solutions to lenders. The SaaS platform applies machine learning and automation to digitize the collections process — automating settlements, offering borrowers customized repayment plans, orchestrating multi-channel borrower communications, tracking overdue accounts, sending automated reminders, and surfacing real-time reporting and analytics — helping lenders collect and liquidate their consumer loan portfolios. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Bharat Matrimony
providers.description: Bharat Matrimony is one of India's largest online matrimonial and matchmaking services and a flagship brand of Matrimony.com Ltd, a publicly listed Indian consumer-internet company. It helps prospective brides and grooms find life partners through profile creation, community- and region-specific matrimony sites, search and matching, messaging, and premium assisted-matchmaking and wedding services. Added to the API Evangelist network via VC-portfolio discovery (Bessemer Venture Partners, Canaan Partners); no public developer API program or OpenAPI surface was found at the time of enrichment. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: Bluelearn
providers.description: Bluelearn was an India-based community-driven learning and edtech startup backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company appears inactive - its primary domain (bluelearn.in) no longer serves a product site and instead resolves to a parked GoDaddy lander page, with no reachable HTTPS endpoint, developer portal, documentation, or public API surface. No OpenAPI, SDK, or other machine-readable API artifacts were found to search, generate, or derive from. This profile remains a lead pending any revived public developer surface.

providers.name: Bluestone
providers.description: BlueStone is one of India's largest online retailers of fine jewellery, founded in 2011 by Gaurav Singh Kushwaha and headquartered in Bangalore. It runs an omnichannel model spanning its e-commerce storefront and 125+ physical stores across India, offering 7,000+ BIS-hallmarked and certified designs in gold, diamond, gemstone, and platinum, plus services such as lifetime exchange, buyback, 30-day returns, and personal video consultations. The company is backed by Accel. BlueStone publishes no public developer portal or API; this profile captures the company's identity and a probed domain-security posture for the network.

providers.name: Byjus
providers.description: Byju's is an Indian educational technology company founded in 2011 by Byju Raveendran and Divya Gokulnath and headquartered in Bengaluru, India. It offered app-based adaptive learning for K-12 students and preparation for competitive exams such as JEE, NEET, and civil services, and expanded through acquisitions including Aakash, WhiteHat Jr, Toppr, Osmo, Epic, and Great Learning. Once among the world's most valuable edtech startups, the company entered insolvency proceedings in India following a widely reported financial collapse. Byju's does not publish a public developer program or API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record awaiting any future developer surface.

providers.name: CapriCoast
providers.description: CapriCoast (CapriCoast Home Solutions Pvt Ltd) was a Bengaluru, India based online modular-furniture and modular-kitchen retailer, founded in 2014 and backed by Accel Partners and RB Investments. It offered an online 3D catalog of kitchens and wardrobes with designs pre-customized for project floor plans. The company was acquired by HomeLane in November 2017 and no longer operates independently; its domain (capricoast.com) is now parked/for-sale and it publishes no developer, API, or documentation surface. Sector: consumer. Retained in the network as an Accel portfolio record; no API artifacts are available to enrich.

providers.name: Craftsvilla
providers.description: Craftsvilla was an India-based online marketplace for ethnic and handcrafted products — sarees, ethnic apparel, jewelry, footwear, accessories, beauty and home decor sourced from artisans, weavers and small sellers across India. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Mumbai, it was backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, Nexus Venture Partners and Global Founders Capital before winding down its consumer operations around 2019 amid financial difficulties. It was surfaced as a Lightspeed portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Enrichment found no live public developer surface: the storefront domain now serves a broken AWS S3 redirect (www.craftsvilla.com is NXDOMAIN) and there is no API, developer portal, documentation, /.well-known/ discovery, or llms.txt to harvest.

providers.name: Culinarybrands
providers.description: Culinary Brands is an Indian foodservice and beverage operator on a mission to prove that fresh, quality food is possible without compromising on taste. The company builds and runs a portfolio of well-known food and coffee brands across India, including Subway (sandwiches / QSR), Lavazza (coffee), and Fresh & Honest (coffee and vending), with a stated focus on sustainability, diversity and inclusion, governance, and CSR. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the public web presence is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, documentation, or product API surface at this time.

providers.name: Edukart
providers.description: EduKart was an Indian online education startup, backed by 500 Startups (500 Global), that sold certificate, diploma and degree courses from partner universities and training institutes to Indian learners. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The company is now defunct — repeated probes of edukart.com find a parked hosting placeholder rather than a live business, and no developer, API, documentation or SDK surface exists to catalog.

providers.name: EduPristine
providers.description: EduPristine is a Mumbai-based finance, accounting, and analytics training institute founded in 2008, offering classroom and online certification-prep and professional up-skilling programs. Its catalog spans financial modeling, CFA, FRM, ACCA, US CPA and US CMA, business analytics and data science, digital marketing, financial accounting (Big 4 aligned), and healthcare/medical coding. EduPristine runs training centers across India alongside self-paced and instructor-led online courses, and is part of Adtalem Global Education. Sector: edtech. No public developer API or documented API surface was found during enrichment; the corporate website sits behind a WAF that blocks automated discovery of a well-known or developer surface.

providers.name: Ethereal Exploration Guild
providers.description: Ethereal Exploration Guild (EtherealX) is an Indian spacetech company founded in 2022 in Bengaluru by Manu J. Nair, Prashant Sharma, and Shubhayu Sardar, building fully reusable medium-lift launch vehicles. Its lead product, the Razor Crest Mk-1 (RCM1), targets roughly 25 tons to low Earth orbit with high launch cadence, up to 16 orbit insertions per flight, and 72-96 hour turnaround. The company has manufactured its 80kN reusable upper-stage engine (Pegasus) using a proprietary Full Flow Segregated Cooling Cycle (FFSCC) and operates a large private rocket testing facility in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu. EtherealX has raised on the order of $26M across multiple rounds, including a Series A in December 2025. The company offers launch services rather than any developer-facing API or platform.

providers.name: Fashionara
providers.description: Fashionara was an Indian premium online fashion retailer that launched in 2012 as a curated "e-fashion mall" selling ladies, men's and kids apparel, footwear and lifestyle goods. It ran a flash-sale "events" model on a Magento storefront, carried more than 200 international labels alongside Indian brands including Kenneth Cole, Calvin Klein, Fossil, Adidas, Benetton, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, Clarks and Arrow, and operated a quirky in-house sub-brand called F.lea Bazaar. It offered free shipping over Rs. 799, free returns, next-day delivery in eight Indian cities, a style-advisor booking service and an Android app (com.fnara.main). The company was backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Fashionara never published a public API, developer portal, SDK or OpenAPI definition — a scan of more than 8,000 archived fashionara.com URLs found no /api, /developer, /docs, /swagger, /oauth or /graphql paths, and no api/developer subdomain was ever archived. The storefront went dark in mid-2016 and the domain no longer resolves. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Fortigo
providers.description: Fortigo Network Logistics Pvt. Ltd. (4TiGO) was a Bengaluru, India technology-enabled logistics and supply-chain network platform, founded in 2015, operating an online marketplace for freight/truck transportation alongside a Digital Supply Chain Control Tower SaaS. It was backed by Accel and Nandan Nilekani's NRJN Family Trust, raising roughly $23.5M across five rounds. As of this enrichment pass the company appears deadpooled/defunct: its 4tigo.com site is unreachable (connection refused across all hosts) and no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition could be located. No API artifacts were enriched because there is no live developer surface.

providers.name: Freshmenu
providers.description: FreshMenu is a Bengaluru-based full-stack food-technology company that operates its own cloud kitchens and cooks, packages, and delivers a daily-changing menu of fresh gourmet meals directly to consumers. Unlike aggregator marketplaces, FreshMenu owns the end-to-end experience — from culinary R&D and kitchen operations to its consumer ordering website and mobile apps — serving Bengaluru, Mumbai, and the Delhi/NCR region (New Delhi and Gurgaon). The company is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and was surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It publishes a consumer ordering experience but no public API or developer program; this profile captures its identity and infrastructure posture for the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: GlowRoad
providers.description: GlowRoad is an Indian social-commerce and reselling platform, headquartered in Bengaluru and founded in 2017, that enabled individuals — predominantly home-based women entrepreneurs — to resell fashion, home, and lifestyle products to their social networks over WhatsApp and Facebook without holding inventory. The company was acquired by Amazon India in 2021 and its reselling model was subsequently folded into Amazon's operations. GlowRoad runs a consumer mobile app and a supplier-onboarding funnel rather than a public developer program; as of this enrichment pass no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, or partner API surface is published, and the public web endpoints return HTTP 503.

providers.name: Good Glamm Group
providers.description: Good Glamm Group is an India-based content-to-commerce conglomerate in the personal care and cosmetics sector, founded in September 2021 by Darpan Sanghvi, Priyanka Gill, and Naiyya Saggi and briefly valued as a unicorn after 2021 Series D funding. Its house of brands includes MyGlamm, St.Botanica, The Moms Co, Sirona, Organic Harvest, POPxo, ScoopWhoop, BabyChakra, MissMalini, and Tweak, spanning India, Dubai, Singapore, and the USA. The group was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the goodglamm.com domain serves a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) stakeholder portal, and no public developer API or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Goyaz Silver Jewellery
providers.description: Goyaz Silver Jewellery is a Hyderabad-based Indian jewellery retail brand founded in January 2023 by Priyanka Vemuluri, specializing in 92.5 premium and gold-plated silver jewellery that blends traditional Indian craftsmanship with contemporary, occasion-led design. Operating a chain of 18 retail stores across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka (including Kukatpally, Punjagutta, Suchitra Circle, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam), Goyaz positions gold-plated silver as an accessible luxury alternative to gold. In October 2025 the company raised a Rs 130 crore (~$14.6M) Series A round led by Norwest Venture Partners, its first institutional funding, to expand its retail footprint, strengthen design and manufacturing, and enhance its omnichannel experience. The company operates an online storefront and social commerce presence but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: HeartyyFresh
providers.description: HeartyyFresh is a mobile-first Indian grocery delivery service that lets customers order fresh Indian groceries and household staples for home delivery through its iOS and Android apps. The consumer offering centers on convenience and quality, promoting a first-time incentive of 20% off the first five orders placed through the app. HeartyyFresh operates as a direct-to-consumer grocery app (published under the com.rahein.heartyyfresh Android package and the "HeartyyFresh - Indian Grocery" iOS listing) rather than a developer platform; it exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched for identity only.

providers.name: Incognito Technologies
providers.description: Incognito Technologies Private Limited is a Jaipur, India-based information technology services and software consultancy (incorporated December 2011, CIN U72200RJ2011PTC036364, offices in Bani Park, Jaipur). The firm offers custom software development, web and mobile application development, cloud and data services, IT infrastructure management, digital transformation, and enterprise ERP consulting. It is a professional-services provider rather than a public API producer; as of this enrichment pass no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI) has been located, and the corporate website (inctech.in) was unreachable when probed.

providers.name: Kishlay Foods
providers.description: Kishlay Foods is a snack-food manufacturing company based in Guwahati, Assam, India, operating since 2003. The company produces premium potato chips, namkeens, and traditional Indian savory snacks, with regional varieties such as Aloo Bhujia, Bengali Mix, Chakna Mix, Cocktail Peanut, and Chana Jor Garam. Kishlay Foods runs a consumer/distributor marketing website and recruits distributor partners across the region; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, webhook, or developer-portal surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Mensabrands
providers.description: Mensa Brands (now operating as BRND.ME) is a Bangalore, India based "house of brands" / digital-first brand aggregator founded in 2021 by Ananth Narayanan. Following the Thrasio model, it acquires, operates and scales digital-native consumer brands across fashion, beauty, personal care, home and general merchandise, selling through marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra as well as direct-to-consumer channels. The company reached unicorn status in 2021 and is backed by investors including Norwest Venture Partners, Accel, Prosus Ventures, Tiger Global and Alpha Wave. Its original domain mensabrands.com now redirects to brndme.in. This is a consumer-brands operating company; enrichment found no public developer or API surface (no docs/developer/api subdomains, no /.well-known documents, no llms.txt) beyond the marketing site's WordPress CMS, so no API artifacts were produced.

providers.name: Meolaa
providers.description: Meolaa is an AI-first, digitally native FMCG company based in India, founded in 2023 by Ishita Sawant. It began as a curated e-commerce marketplace for clean, sustainable, direct-to-consumer brands across fashion, beauty, home, and baby care, and is expanding into building a portfolio of purpose-driven in-house microbrands (including HIRA) powered by a shared AI and data platform for cross-brand innovation, supply-chain resilience, and marketing. The company raised a $6M Pre-Series A round led by General Catalyst with Claypond Capital, Colossa Ventures, Turbostart Global, and Kunal Shah. Meolaa is a consumer company and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Moglix
providers.description: Moglix is an Indian B2B commerce platform for industrial and MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations) procurement, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Noida, India, with a Singapore base. Through MoglixBusiness it supplies enterprises with industrial products — safety equipment, electricals, power tools, fasteners, packaging, and office supplies — alongside supply-chain, procurement-software, and financing services. A unicorn backed by Accel and other investors, Moglix operates across manufacturing supply chains in India and international markets. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment probing found an internal API host (api.moglix.com) but no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or documented API surface.

providers.name: MyGlamm
providers.description: MyGlamm is an Indian direct-to-consumer beauty and cosmetics brand operated by Sanghvi Beauty and Technologies Private Limited (the Good Glamm Group), backed by Accel. It sells makeup, skincare and personal-care products online and through retail. As of mid-2026 the parent company is undergoing corporate insolvency proceedings and its primary domain serves an insolvency stakeholder notice portal. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Myntra
providers.description: Myntra is one of India's largest fashion and lifestyle e-commerce platforms, offering apparel, footwear, accessories, and beauty products across its own and third-party brands. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Bengaluru, Myntra was acquired by Flipkart (Walmart) in 2014 and operates a consumer marketplace at myntra.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Myntra does not publish a public developer API program; its developer/API hosts resolve behind Akamai but are not openly documented.

providers.name: OYO
